```csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using Synthetic.Shared.UI;
using Synthetic.Core;
using Synthetic.Modules.MergeDuplicates.ViewModels;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
using Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.MergeDuplicates.Views
{
    public partial class MergeDetailedReviewWindow : Window
    {
        public MergeDetailedReviewWindow(IntPtr mainWindowHandle)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            RevitWindowHelper.SetOwner(this, mainWindowHandle);
            DataContextChanged += (sender, args) =>
            {
                if (DataContext is MergeDetailedReviewViewModel vm)
                {
                    vm.CloseAction = () =>
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            this.DialogResult = true;
                        }
                        catch (InvalidOperationException)
                        {
                        }
                        this.Close();
                    };
                }
            };
        }
        private void BtnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                this.DialogResult = false;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException)
            {
            }
            this.Close();
        }
        private void RenameTextBox_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.Text)) return;
            char[] illegalChars = new char[] { '\\', ':', '{', '}', '[', ']', '|', ';', '<', '>', '?', '\'', '~' };
            if (e.Text.IndexOfAny(illegalChars) >= 0)
            {
                e.Handled = true;
                if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.TextBox textBox)
                {
                    var originalToolTip = textBox.ToolTip;
                    var toolTip = new System.Windows.Controls.ToolTip
                    {
                        Content = "Family names cannot contain any of the following characters:\n\\ : { } [ ] | ; < > ? ' ~",
                        IsOpen = true,
                        PlacementTarget = textBox,
                        Placement = System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.PlacementMode.Top,
                        StaysOpen = false
                    };
                    textBox.ToolTip = toolTip;
                    var timer = new DispatcherTimer
                    {
                        Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)
                    };
                    timer.Tick += (s, args) =>
                    {
                        toolTip.IsOpen = false;
                        textBox.ToolTip = originalToolTip;
                        timer.Stop();
                    };
                    timer.Start();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```xml
<Window x:Class="Synthetic.Modules.MergeDuplicates.Views.MergeDuplicatesWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"

        Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#F1F1F1">

                    </Style>
                </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                <DataGrid.RowDetailsTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateClusterModel}">
                        <Border Background="#151515" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1,0,1,1" Padding="15,10">
                            <StackPanel>
                                <TextBlock Text="Include Items for Merge:" FontSize="11" Foreground="#007ACC" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                                <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Items}">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                        <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                                        </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateItemModel}">
                                            <CheckBox Content="{Binding ItemName}" 
                                                      IsChecked="{Binding IsIncludedForMerge, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                      Foreground="White" Margin="0,0,20,5" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Border>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </DataGrid.RowDetailsTemplate>
                <DataGrid.Columns>
                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Duplicate Group Name" Binding="{Binding ClusterName}" Width="2*" IsReadOnly="True">
                        <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                            <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="5,0"/>
                            </Style>
                        </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                    </DataGridTextColumn>

                    <!-- Mismatches / Status -->
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Status Warnings" Width="1.5*">
                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateClusterModel}">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="5,0">
                                    <TextBlock Text="🛑 Blocked: Conflicts " Foreground="#FF5555" FontWeight="Bold"
                                               Visibility="{Binding IsBlocked, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="⚠️ Parameter Mismatch " Foreground="#E0A030" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                               Visibility="{Binding HasSchemaMismatch, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="📐 Origin Mismatch " Foreground="#E0A030" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                               Visibility="{Binding HasOriginMismatch, Converter={StaticResource BooleanToVisibilityConverter}}"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="✓ Harmonious" Foreground="#55AA55" FontWeight="SemiBold">
                                        <TextBlock.Style>
                                            <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                <Style.Triggers>
                                                    <MultiDataTrigger>
                                                        <MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                            <Condition Binding="{Binding HasSchemaMismatch}" Value="False"/>
                                                            <Condition Binding="{Binding HasOriginMismatch}" Value="False"/>
                                                            <Condition Binding="{Binding IsBlocked}" Value="False"/>
                                                        </MultiDataTrigger.Conditions>
                                                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                    </MultiDataTrigger>
                                                </Style.Triggers>
                                            </Style>
                                        </TextBlock.Style>
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                    <!-- ComboBox to choose Primary Survivor -->
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Primary Survivor (Bold is Default)" Width="2.5*">
                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateClusterModel}">
                                <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding Items}" 
                                          SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedPrimary, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                          Height="24" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" Margin="5,0"
                                          Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="White" BorderBrush="#3F3F46">
                                    <ComboBox.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateItemModel}">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding ItemName}">
                                                <TextBlock.Style>
                                                    <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsPrimary}" Value="True">
                                                                <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
                                                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#007ACC"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger>
                                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                                    </Style>
                                                </TextBlock.Style>
                                            </TextBlock>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ComboBox.ItemTemplate>
                                </ComboBox>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                    <!-- Add Straggler Button (+) -->
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Stragglers" Width="Auto">
                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateClusterModel}">
                                <Button Content="+" 
                                        Command="{Binding DataContext.CmdAddStragglers, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=DataGrid}}" 
                                        CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                        Width="28" Height="22" Margin="5,0"
                                        Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="Bold" FontSize="14" ToolTip="Force missing straggler elements of the same category into this cluster."/>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                    <!-- Actions (Queue, Detailed Analysis, Move) -->
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Actions" Width="Auto">
                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateClusterModel}">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                    <Button Content="Queue" 
                                            Command="{Binding DataContext.CmdAddToQueue, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=DataGrid}}" 
                                            CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                            Width="75" Height="22" Margin="3,0"
                                            Background="#007ACC" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                            ToolTip="Add this cluster to the execution merge queue."/>
                                    
                                    <Button Content="Detailed Analysis" 
                                            Command="{Binding DataContext.CmdDetailedReview, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=DataGrid}}" 
                                            CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                            Width="110" Height="22" Margin="3,0"
                                            Background="#A05030" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                            ToolTip="Launch granular side-by-side comparison and override individual parameters."/>
                                    
                                    <Button Command="{Binding DataContext.CmdMoveItem, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=DataGrid}}" 
                                            CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                            Width="24" Height="22" Margin="3,0"
                                            Background="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="0"
                                            ToolTip="Move Clusters: Moves a selected duplicate element/type from this cluster to another cluster to manually adjust groupings.">
                                        <Path Data="M3,7 H17 M17,7 L13,3 M17,7 L13,11 M21,15 H7 M7,15 L11,11 M7,15 L11,19" 
                                              Stroke="#F1F1F1" StrokeThickness="1.5" Width="14" Height="14" Stretch="Uniform" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                    </Button>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                </DataGrid.Columns>
            </DataGrid>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Grid Splitter -->
        <GridSplitter Grid.Row="2" Height="4" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" VerticalAlignment="Center" Background="#3F3F46" Margin="0,5"/>

        <!-- 2. QUEUE GRID AREA -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="3" Margin="0,10,0,15">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Queued Merges (Active Queue)" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#FFFFFF" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>

            <DataGrid Grid.Row="1" ItemsSource="{Binding QueuedClusters}" Style="{StaticResource PremiumDataGridStyle}">
                <DataGrid.Columns>
                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Duplicate Group Name" Binding="{Binding ClusterName}" Width="2*" IsReadOnly="True">
                        <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                            <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="5,0"/>
                            </Style>
                        </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                    </DataGridTextColumn>

                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Target Survivor" Binding="{Binding SelectedPrimary.ItemName}" Width="2.5*" IsReadOnly="True">
                        <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                            <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="5,0"/>
                                <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#007ACC"/>
                            </Style>
                        </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                    </DataGridTextColumn>

                    <!-- Remove Button -->
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Action" Width="Auto">
                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type models:DuplicateClusterModel}">
                                <Button Content="Remove" 
                                        Command="{Binding DataContext.CmdRemoveFromQueue, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=DataGrid}}" 
                                        CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                        Width="80" Height="22" Margin="5,0"
                                        Background="#A03030" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                </DataGrid.Columns>
            </DataGrid>
        </Grid>

        <!-- 3. FOOTER AREA -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="4" VerticalAlignment="Bottom">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>    <!-- Progress Bar -->
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/> <!-- Buttons -->
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Progress Indicator -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,20,0">
                <TextBlock Text="Progress: " VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#808080" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <ProgressBar Value="{Binding ProgressValue}" Maximum="{Binding ProgressMax}" Width="200" Height="14" 
                             Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#007ACC" BorderBrush="#3F3F46"/>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Operations / Actions -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                <Button Content="Cancel Scan" Command="{Binding CmdCancelScan}" Width="100" Height="28" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                        Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"/>
                
                <Button Content="Process Merge" 
                        Command="{Binding CmdProcessMerge}" 
                        CommandParameter="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                        Width="110" Height="28"
                        Background="#007ACC" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

### File: src/SyntheticShared/Modules/RevitDOM/CategoryGraphicOverrideModel.cs
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using RevitView = Autodesk.Revit.DB.View;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class CategoryGraphicOverridesModel : ObjectModel
    {
        public CategoryIdModel Category { get; set; } = new CategoryIdModel();
        public CategoryIdModel? ParentCategory { get; set; }
        public bool IsHidden { get; set; }
        public OverrideGraphicSettingsModel? GraphicOverride { get; set; }
        public CategoryGraphicOverridesModel () { }
        public CategoryGraphicOverridesModel (RevitDB.Category category, RevitView view)
        {
            RevitDoc document = view.Document;
            this.Category = new CategoryIdModel(category, document, false);
            this.IsHidden = view.GetCategoryHidden(category.Id);
            if (category.Parent != null)
            {
                this.ParentCategory = new CategoryIdModel(category.Parent, document, false);
            }
            RevitDB.OverrideGraphicSettings overrideSettings = view.GetCategoryOverrides(category.Id);
            OverrideGraphicSettingsModel serialOverride = new OverrideGraphicSettingsModel(category, overrideSettings, document);
            if (serialOverride.IsModified)
            {
                this.GraphicOverride = serialOverride;
            }
        }
        public bool IsModified()
        {
            bool modified = false;
            if (this.GraphicOverride != null)
            {
                if (this.GraphicOverride.IsModified) { modified = true; }
            }
            if (this.IsHidden == true) { modified = true; }
            return modified;
        }
public void ModifyOverrideGraphicSettings(RevitView view)
        {
            RevitDoc document = view.Document;
            RevitDB.Category? category = Category.GetCategory(document);
            if (category != null)
            {
                view.SetCategoryHidden(category.Id, this.IsHidden);
                if (this.GraphicOverride != null)
                {
                    RevitDB.OverrideGraphicSettings ogs = this.GraphicOverride.ToOverrideGraphicSettings(document);
                    view.SetCategoryOverrides(category.Id, ogs);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### File: src/SyntheticShared/Modules/RevitDOM/CategoryIdModel.cs
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using RevitCategory = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Category;
using RevitElemId = Autodesk.Revit.DB.ElementId;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class CategoryIdModel : ObjectModel
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public long Id { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public RevitCategory? Category { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public RevitDoc? Document { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public bool IsTemplate { get; set; }
        public bool ShouldSerializeId()
        {
            return !IsTemplate;
        }
        public CategoryIdModel ()
        {
            this.IsTemplate = false;        
        }
        public CategoryIdModel (RevitCategory category,
             RevitDoc Document, bool IsTemplate)
        {
            this.Category = category;
            this.Document = Document;
            this.Name = category.Name;
            this.IsTemplate = IsTemplate;
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
            this.Id = category.Id.IntegerValue;
#else
            this.Id = category.Id.Value;
#endif
        }
        public RevitCategory? GetCategory(
             RevitDoc? Document)
        {
            if (Document == null) return this.Category;
            if(Category == null)
            {
                if (this.Id != 0)
                {
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                    this.Category = RevitCategory.GetCategory(Document, new RevitElemId((int)this.Id));
#else
                    this.Category = RevitCategory.GetCategory(Document, new RevitElemId(this.Id));
#endif
                }
                if (this.Category == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.Name))
                {
                    this.Category = Document.Settings.Categories
                        .Cast<RevitCategory>()
                        .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name.Equals(this.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    if (this.Category == null)
                    {
                        foreach (RevitCategory parent in Document.Settings.Categories)
                        {
                            RevitCategory? sub = parent.SubCategories
                                .Cast<RevitCategory>()
                                .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name.Equals(this.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                            if (sub != null)
                            {
                                this.Category = sub;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return this.Category;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using System.Linq;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using RevitCategory = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Category;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Synthetic.Infrastructure.Serialization;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
using Synthetic.Shared.RevitAPI;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class CategoryModel : ElementModel
    {
        public override string Class
        {
            get
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ParentCategoryName))
                {
                    return ParentCategoryName!;
                }
                return "Built-In Categories";
            }
            set { }
        }
        public override string Category
        {
            get => "Autodesk.Revit.DB.Category";
            set { }
        }
        public string? ParentCategoryName { get; set; }
        private string? _categoryGroupLevel1;
        public string CategoryGroupLevel1
        {
            get
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_categoryGroupLevel1))
                {
                    bool isLineStyle = string.Equals(Name, "Lines", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                       string.Equals(ParentCategoryName, "Lines", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    bool isImported = (Name != null && (Name.StartsWith("Imports in ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                      Name.IndexOf(".dwg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)) ||
                                      (ParentCategoryName != null && (ParentCategoryName.StartsWith("Imports in ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                      ParentCategoryName.IndexOf(".dwg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0));
                    if (isLineStyle) return "Line Styles";
                    if (isImported) return "Imported Categories";
                    return "Model Categories";
                }
                return _categoryGroupLevel1!;
            }
            set => _categoryGroupLevel1 = value;
        }
        private string? _categoryGroupLevel2;
        public string CategoryGroupLevel2
        {
            get
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_categoryGroupLevel2))
                {
                    return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ParentCategoryName) ? ParentCategoryName! : (Name ?? string.Empty);
                }
                return _categoryGroupLevel2!;
            }
            set => _categoryGroupLevel2 = value;
        }
        private bool? _isCuttable;
        public bool IsCuttable
        {
            get => _isCuttable ?? true;
            set => _isCuttable = value;
        }
        public ColorModel? LineColor { get; set; }
        public ElementIdModel? Material { get; set; }
        public int? LineWeightProjection { get; set; }
        public int? LineWeightCut { get; set; }
        public ElementIdModel? LinePatternProjection { get; set; }
        public ElementIdModel? LinePatternCut { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public CategoryIdModel CategoryId { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public RevitCategory? RevitCategory
        {
            get => this.CategoryId.Category;
            set => this.CategoryId.Category = value;
        }
        public CategoryModel() : base()
        {
            this.CategoryId = new CategoryIdModel();
            this.IsTemplate = true;
            this.ElementId = new ElementIdModel { Class = "Autodesk.Revit.DB.Category" };
        }
        public CategoryModel(RevitCategory category, RevitDoc Document, bool IsTemplate)
        {
            this.IsTemplate = IsTemplate;
            this.CategoryId = new CategoryIdModel(category, Document, IsTemplate);
            long catIdVal;
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
            catIdVal = category.Id.IntegerValue;
#else
            catIdVal = category.Id.Value;
#endif
            this.ElementId = new ElementIdModel
            {
                Name = category.Name,
                Class = "Autodesk.Revit.DB.Category",
                Category = category.Name,
                Id = catIdVal
            };
            this.IsCuttable = category.IsCuttable;
            if (category.IsCuttable)
            {
                try
                {
                    this.LineWeightCut = category.GetLineWeight(RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Cut);
                    RevitDB.ElementId linePatternCutId = category.GetLinePatternId(RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Cut);
                    if (linePatternCutId == RevitDB.ElementId.InvalidElementId || linePatternCutId == RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId())
                    {
                        long solidIdVal;

            }

        public void SyncFromParameters()
        {
            if (this.Parameters == null) return;
            var pLineWeightProjection = this.Parameters.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == "LineWeightProjection");
            if (pLineWeightProjection != null && int.TryParse(pLineWeightProjection.Value, out int lwp))
            {
                this.LineWeightProjection = lwp;
            }
            else
            {
                this.LineWeightProjection = null;
            }
            var pLineWeightCut = this.Parameters.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == "LineWeightCut");
            if (pLineWeightCut != null && int.TryParse(pLineWeightCut.Value, out int lwc))
            {

            else

                this.LineWeightCut = null;
            }
            var pLineColor = this.Parameters.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == "LineColor");
            if (pLineColor != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pLineColor.Value))
            {
                var parts = pLineColor.Value!.Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (parts.Length == 3 &&
                    byte.TryParse(parts[0].Trim(), out byte r) &&
                    byte.TryParse(parts[1].Trim(), out byte g) &&
                    byte.TryParse(parts[2].Trim(), out byte b))
                {
                    this.LineColor = new ColorModel(r, g, b);

            var pLinePatternProjection = this.Parameters.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == "LinePatternProjection");
            if (pLinePatternProjection != null)
            {
                if (pLinePatternProjection.ValueElemId != null)
                {
                    this.LinePatternProjection = pLinePatternProjection.ValueElemId;
                }
                else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pLinePatternProjection.Value))

                }
                else

                }

            if (pLinePatternCut != null)

public static RevitDB.Category? ModifyCategory(CategoryModel serialCategory, RevitDoc document)
        {
            RevitDB.Category? category = null;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serialCategory.ParentCategoryName))
            {
                RevitDB.Category? parentCategory = document.Settings.Categories
                    .Cast<RevitDB.Category>()
                    .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name.Equals(serialCategory.ParentCategoryName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (parentCategory != null)
                {
                    category = parentCategory.SubCategories
                        .Cast<RevitDB.Category>()
                        .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name.Equals(serialCategory.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                    if (category == null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            category = document.Settings.Categories.NewSubcategory(parentCategory, serialCategory.Name);
                        }
                        catch (Exception)
                        {
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                category = serialCategory.GetCategory(document);
                if (category == null && serialCategory.Id != 0)
                {
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                    category = RevitDB.Category.GetCategory(document, new RevitDB.ElementId((int)serialCategory.Id));
#else
                    category = RevitDB.Category.GetCategory(document, new RevitDB.ElementId(serialCategory.Id));
#endif
                }
            }
            if (category != null)
            {
                if (category.IsCuttable)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        if (serialCategory.LineWeightCut.HasValue && serialCategory.LineWeightCut.Value >= 1 && serialCategory.LineWeightCut.Value <= 16)
                        {
                            category.SetLineWeight(serialCategory.LineWeightCut.Value, RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Cut);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Autodesk.Revit.Exceptions.InvalidOperationException)
                    {
                    }
                }
                if (serialCategory.LineWeightProjection.HasValue && serialCategory.LineWeightProjection.Value >= 1 && serialCategory.LineWeightProjection.Value <= 16)
                {
                    category.SetLineWeight(serialCategory.LineWeightProjection.Value, RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Projection);
                }
                if (serialCategory.LineColor != null)
                {
                    category.LineColor = serialCategory.LineColor.ToColor();
                }
                if (serialCategory.Material != null)
                {
                    var matElem = serialCategory.Material.GetElem(document);
                    if (matElem is RevitDB.Material mat)
                    {
                        category.Material = mat;
                    }
                    else if (serialCategory.Material.Name == "<By Category>" || string.IsNullOrEmpty(serialCategory.Material.Name))
                    {
                        category.Material = null;
                    }
                }
                if (category.IsCuttable && serialCategory.LinePatternCut != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        long solidIdVal;
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                        solidIdVal = RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId().IntegerValue;
#else
                        solidIdVal = RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId().Value;
#endif
                        if (serialCategory.LinePatternCut.Id == solidIdVal || 
                            string.Equals(serialCategory.LinePatternCut.Name, "Solid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            category.SetLinePatternId(RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId(), RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Cut);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            var lp = serialCategory.LinePatternCut.GetElem(document) as RevitDB.LinePatternElement;
                            if (lp != null)
                            {
                                category.SetLinePatternId(lp.Id, RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Cut);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Autodesk.Revit.Exceptions.InvalidOperationException)
                    {
                    }
                }
                if (serialCategory.LinePatternProjection != null)
                {
                    long solidIdVal;
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                    solidIdVal = RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId().IntegerValue;
#else
                    solidIdVal = RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId().Value;
#endif
                    if (serialCategory.LinePatternProjection.Id == solidIdVal || 
                        string.Equals(serialCategory.LinePatternProjection.Name, "Solid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        category.SetLinePatternId(RevitDB.LinePatternElement.GetSolidPatternId(), RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Projection);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        var lp = serialCategory.LinePatternProjection.GetElem(document) as RevitDB.LinePatternElement;
                        if (lp != null)
                        {
                            category.SetLinePatternId(lp.Id, RevitDB.GraphicsStyleType.Projection);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return category;
        }
    }
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class ColorModel : ObjectModel
    {
        public Byte Blue { get; set; }
        public Byte Green { get; set; }
        public Byte Red { get; set; }
        public bool IsValid { get; set; }
        public ColorModel()
        {
            this.IsValid = false;
        }
        public ColorModel (Byte Red, Byte Green, Byte Blue)
        {
            this.Red = Red;
            this.Green = Green;
            this.Blue = Blue;
            this.IsValid = true;
        }
        public ColorModel (RevitDB.Color color)
        {
            this.IsValid = color.IsValid;
            if (color.IsValid)
            {
                this.Red = color.Red;
                this.Green = color.Green;
                this.Blue = color.Blue;
            }
        }
        public static ColorModel? ByJSON (string JSON)
        {
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ColorModel>(JSON);
        }
        public static string ToJSON (ColorModel color)
        {
            return Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(color, Formatting.Indented);
        }
        public RevitDB.Color ToColor ()
        {
            if (this.IsValid)
            {
                return new RevitDB.Color(this.Red, this.Green, this.Blue);
            }
            else
            {
                return RevitDB.Color.InvalidColorValue;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using RevitCS = Autodesk.Revit.DB.CompoundStructure;
using RevitCSLayer = Autodesk.Revit.DB.CompoundStructureLayer;
using Synthetic.Infrastructure.Serialization;
using Synthetic.Modules.MergeDuplicates.Handlers;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
using Synthetic.Shared.RevitAPI;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class CompoundStructureModel
    {
        public List<SerialCompoundStructureLayer> Layers { get; set; } = new List<SerialCompoundStructureLayer>();
        public List<string> WallSweeps { get; set; } = new List<string>();
        public CompoundStructureModel () { }
        public CompoundStructureModel (RevitCS CompoundStructure,
             RevitDoc Document)
        {
            this.Layers = new List<SerialCompoundStructureLayer>();
            this.WallSweeps = new List<string>();
            IList<RevitCSLayer> csLayers = CompoundStructure.GetLayers();
            int structuralIndex = CompoundStructure.StructuralMaterialIndex;
            for (int i = 0; i < csLayers.Count; i++)
            {
                RevitCSLayer csLayer = csLayers[i];
                var layerModel = new SerialCompoundStructureLayer(csLayer, Document);
                layerModel.StructuralMaterial = (i == structuralIndex);
#if REVIT2026
                int priority = 0;
                try
                {
                    var getPriorityMethod = CompoundStructure.GetType().GetMethod("GetPriority", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
                    if (getPriorityMethod != null)
                    {
                        var priorityObj = getPriorityMethod.Invoke(CompoundStructure, new object[] { i });
                        if (priorityObj is int pVal)
                        {
                            priority = pVal;
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch {}
                layerModel.Priority = priority;
#endif
                this.Layers.Add(layerModel);
            }
        }
        public RevitCS CreateCompoundStructure(
             RevitDoc Document)
        {
            IList<RevitCSLayer> csLayers = new List<RevitCSLayer>();
            int structuralIndex = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < this.Layers.Count; i++)
            {
                SerialCompoundStructureLayer layer = this.Layers[i];
                csLayers.Add(layer.CreateCompoundStructureLayer(Document));
                if (layer.StructuralMaterial)
                {
                    structuralIndex = i;
                }
            }
            RevitCS cs = RevitCS.CreateSimpleCompoundStructure(csLayers);
            if (structuralIndex >= 0 && structuralIndex < csLayers.Count)
            {
                cs.StructuralMaterialIndex = structuralIndex;
            }
#if REVIT2026
            for (int i = 0; i < this.Layers.Count; i++)
            {
                try
                {
                    var setPriorityMethod = cs.GetType().GetMethod("SetPriority", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(int) });
                    if (setPriorityMethod != null)
                    {
                        setPriorityMethod.Invoke(cs, new object[] { i, this.Layers[i].Priority });
                    }
                }
                catch {}
            }
#endif
            return cs;
        }
    }
    public class SerialCompoundStructureLayer
    {
        public ElementIdModel MaterialId { get; set; } = new ElementIdModel();
        public string Function { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public double Width { get; set; }
        public string DeckEmbeddingType { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public ElementIdModel DeckProfileId { get; set; } = new ElementIdModel();
        public bool LayerCapFlag { get; set; }
        public bool StructuralMaterial { get; set; }
#if REVIT2026
        public int Priority { get; set; }
#endif
        public SerialCompoundStructureLayer () { }
        public SerialCompoundStructureLayer (RevitCSLayer Layer,
             RevitDoc Document)
        {
            this.MaterialId = new ElementIdModel(Layer.MaterialId, Document, false);
            this.Function = Layer.Function.ToString();
            this.Width = Layer.Width;
            this.DeckEmbeddingType = Layer.DeckEmbeddingType.ToString();
            this.DeckProfileId = new ElementIdModel(Layer.DeckProfileId, Document, false);
            this.LayerCapFlag = Layer.LayerCapFlag;
        }
        public RevitCSLayer CreateCompoundStructureLayer (
             RevitDoc Document)
        {
            RevitCSLayer layer = new RevitCSLayer();
            layer.DeckEmbeddingType =
                (RevitDB.StructDeckEmbeddingType)
                Enum.Parse(
                    typeof(RevitDB.StructDeckEmbeddingType),
                    this.DeckEmbeddingType);
            RevitDB.Element? deck = this.DeckProfileId.GetElem(Document);
            if (deck != null)
            {
                layer.DeckProfileId = deck.Id;
            }
            layer.Function =
                (RevitDB.MaterialFunctionAssignment)
                Enum.Parse(
                    typeof(RevitDB.MaterialFunctionAssignment),
                    this.Function);
            layer.LayerCapFlag = this.LayerCapFlag;
            RevitDB.Material? mat = this.MaterialId.GetElem(Document) as RevitDB.Material;
            if (mat != null)
            {
                layer.MaterialId = mat.Id;
            }
            layer.Width = this.Width;
            return layer;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        #endregion
        #region Public Constructors
        public DimensionTypeModel() : base()
        {

        public DimensionTypeModel(RevitDimType? revitElemType, bool IsTemplate) : base(revitElemType, IsTemplate)

            {
                this.DimensionStyle = this.DimensionType.StyleType;
            }
        }
        public DimensionTypeModel(ElementTypeModel serialElement, bool IsTemplate) : base(serialElement.ElementType, IsTemplate)
        {
            if (this.DimensionType != null)
            {
                this.DimensionStyle = this.DimensionType.StyleType;
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Public Methods
        public static RevitDB.DimensionType? CreateDimensionType(DimensionTypeModel serialDimensionType,
             RevitDoc document)
        {
            RevitElemType? template = null;
            Assembly assembly = typeof(RevitElem).Assembly;
            Type? elemClass = assembly.GetType(serialDimensionType.Class);
            if (elemClass != null)
            {
                RevitDB.FilteredElementCollector collector = new RevitDB.FilteredElementCollector(document);
                template = collector
                        .OfClass(elemClass)
                        .OfType<RevitDB.DimensionType>()
                        .Where(elem => elem.StyleType.Equals(serialDimensionType.DimensionStyle))
                        .Where(elem => elem.Name != InternalDimStyleName)
                        .FirstOrDefault();
            }
            return CreateElementTypeByTemplate(serialDimensionType, template, document) as RevitDB.DimensionType;
        }
        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
        {
            return this.ElementId.GetElem(document);
        }
        public List<RevitElem> GetAliasElements_Revit ( RevitDoc document)
        {
            List<RevitElem> elements = new List<RevitElem>();
            if (this.Aliases != null)
            {
                foreach (string aliasName in this.Aliases)
                {
                    Assembly assembly = typeof(RevitElem).Assembly;
                    Type? elemClass = assembly.GetType(this.Class);
                    if (elemClass != null)
                    {
                        RevitElem? elem = Select.ElementByNameClass(aliasName, elemClass, document);
                        if (elem != null)
                        {
                            elements.Add(elem);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return elements;
        }
        public static ElementModel SetAliases (ElementModel serialElement, List<string> aliases)
        {
            if (aliases.Count()>0)
            {
                serialElement.Aliases = aliases;
            }
            return serialElement;
        }
public static RevitElem? ModifyElement(ElementModel serialElement,  RevitDoc document)
        {
            string transactionName = "Modify Element from Serialization";
            if (serialElement.Element != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (!serialElement.Element.IsValidObject || !serialElement.Element.Document.Equals(document))
                    {
                        serialElement.Element = null;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    serialElement.Element = null;
                }
            }
            if (serialElement.Element == null)
            {
                serialElement.Element = serialElement.GetRevitElem(document);
            }
            if (serialElement.Element != null)
            {
                using (Autodesk.Revit.DB.Transaction trans = new Autodesk.Revit.DB.Transaction(document))
                {
                    trans.Start(transactionName);
                    serialElement._ModifyProperties(serialElement.Element);
                    trans.Commit();
                }
            }
            return serialElement.Element;
        }
        public override string ToString()
        {
            return string.Format("{0}(Name=\"{1}\", ID={2})", this.GetType().Name, this.Name, this.Id);
        }
        public static ElementModel ByJSON(string JSON)
        {
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ElementModel>(JSON)!;
        }
        public static string ToJSON(ElementModel serialElement)
        {
            return Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(serialElement, Formatting.Indented);
        }
        #endregion
        #region Helper Functions
virtual protected void _ModifyProperties (RevitElem elem)
        {
            elem.Name = this.Name;
            foreach (ParameterModel paramJson in this.Parameters)
            {
                ParameterModel.ModifyParameter(paramJson, elem);
            }
        }
        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using RevitElem = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Element;
using RevitElemType = Autodesk.Revit.DB.ElementType;
using RevitElemId = Autodesk.Revit.DB.ElementId;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Synthetic.Shared.RevitAPI;
using Synthetic.Modules.MergeDuplicates.Handlers;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class ElementTypeModel : ElementModel
    {
        #region Public Properties
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public RevitElemType? ElementType { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public override RevitElem? Element
        {
            get => this.ElementType;
            set => this.ElementType = (RevitElemType?)value;
        }
        #endregion
        #region Public Constructors
        public ElementTypeModel () : base () { }
        public ElementTypeModel (RevitElemType? revitElemType, bool IsTemplate) : base (revitElemType, IsTemplate) { }
        public ElementTypeModel (ElementModel serialElement, bool IsTemplate) : base (serialElement.Element, IsTemplate) { }
        #endregion
        #region Public Methods
public static RevitElemType? CreateElementTypeByTemplate (ElementTypeModel serialElementType, RevitElemType? templateElemType,
             RevitDoc document)
        {
            string transactionName = "Duplicate Template Element Type";
            RevitElemType? dElem = null;
            RevitElemType? newType = null;
            if (serialElementType.Name != null)
            {
                newType = Synthetic.Shared.RevitAPI.Select.GetElementTypeByName(serialElementType.Name, document) as RevitElemType;
            }
            if (newType == null && serialElementType.ElementId != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    var foundElem = serialElementType.GetRevitElem(document);
                    if (foundElem is RevitElemType foundType)
                    {
                        newType = foundType;
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                }
            }
            ElementTypeModel newSerial = (ElementTypeModel)serialElementType.MemberwiseClone();
            if (newType == null)
            {
                if (templateElemType != null)
                {
                    using (Autodesk.Revit.DB.Transaction trans = new Autodesk.Revit.DB.Transaction(document))
                    {
                        trans.Start(transactionName);
                        newType = templateElemType.Duplicate(serialElementType.Name);
                        trans.Commit();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Console.Write("No Template Family Found");
                }
            }
            if (newType != null)
            {
                newSerial.Element = newType;
                newSerial.UniqueId = newType.UniqueId;
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                newSerial.Id = newType.Id.IntegerValue;
#else
                newSerial.Id = newType.Id.Value;
#endif
                dElem = ElementTypeModel.ModifyElement(newSerial, document) as RevitElemType;
            }
            return dElem;
        }
        public static RevitElemType? CreateElementType (ElementTypeModel serialElementType,
             RevitDoc document)
        {
            RevitElemType? template = null;
            Assembly assembly = typeof(RevitElem).Assembly;
            Type? elemClass = assembly.GetType(serialElementType.Class);
            if (elemClass != null)
            {
                RevitDB.FilteredElementCollector collector = new RevitDB.FilteredElementCollector(document);
                if (elemClass == typeof(RevitDB.TextElementType))
                {
                    collector.WherePasses( new RevitDB.ElementClassFilter(typeof(RevitDB.TextNoteType), true) );
                }
                template = collector
                    .OfClass(elemClass)
                    .OfType<RevitElemType>()
                    .FirstOrDefault();
            }
            return CreateElementTypeByTemplate(serialElementType, template, document);
        }
        #endregion
        public static IDictionary MergeAliasTypes(ElementTypeModel serialElementType,
             RevitDoc document)
        {
            List<RevitElem> elementsMerged = new List<RevitElem>();
            List<RevitElem> elementsFailed = new List<RevitElem>();
            RevitElemType? elemType = null;
            List<RevitElem> aliasTypes = serialElementType.GetAliasElements_Revit(document);
            if (serialElementType.ElementType != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (!serialElementType.ElementType.IsValidObject || !serialElementType.ElementType.Document.Equals(document))
                    {
                        serialElementType.ElementType = null;
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    serialElementType.ElementType = null;
                }
            }
            if (serialElementType.ElementType == null)
            {
                if (serialElementType.Name != null)
                {
                    elemType = Synthetic.Shared.RevitAPI.Select.GetElementTypeByName(serialElementType.Name, document) as RevitElemType;
                }
                if (elemType == null && serialElementType.ElementId != null)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var foundElem = serialElementType.GetRevitElem(document);
                        if (foundElem is RevitElemType foundType)
                        {
                            elemType = foundType;
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                    }
                }
                if (elemType != null)
                {
                    serialElementType.ElementType = elemType;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                elemType = serialElementType.ElementType;
            }
            if (elemType == null)
            {
                elemType = CreateElementType(serialElementType, document);
                if (elemType != null)
                {
                    serialElementType.ElementType = elemType;
                }
            }
            if (elemType != null)
            {
                foreach (RevitElem alias in aliasTypes)
                {
                    if (alias != null)
                    {
                        Dictionary<string, object> r = (Dictionary<string, object>)ElementUtil.MergeElementTypesRevit(alias, elemType);
                        List<RevitElem> m = (List<RevitElem>)r["Merged"];
                        List<RevitElem> f = (List<RevitElem>)r["Failed"];
                        elementsMerged.AddRange(m);
                        elementsFailed.AddRange(f);
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {"Merged", elementsMerged},
                {"Failed", elementsFailed}
            };
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM

    public class EnumModel : ObjectModel

        public string Type { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public EnumModel () { }
        public EnumModel (Type type, Enum value)
        {
            this.Type = type.FullName ?? string.Empty;
            this.Value = value.ToString();
        }
        public EnumModel (string type, string value)
        {
            this.Type = type;
            this.Value = value;
        }
        public Enum ToEnum()
        {
            var parsed = SynthEnum.Parse(this.Type, this.Value);
            if (parsed is Enum e) return e;
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Could not parse enum of type {this.Type} with value {this.Value}");
        }
    }
```

```csharp
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using RevitElem = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Element;
using RevitElemType = Autodesk.Revit.DB.ElementType;
using RevitFilledRegionType = Autodesk.Revit.DB.FilledRegionType;
using RevitElemId = Autodesk.Revit.DB.ElementId;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using System.Windows.Forms.VisualStyles;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class FilledRegionTypeModel : ElementTypeModel
    {
        #region Public Properties
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public RevitFilledRegionType? FilledRegionType { get; set; }
        [JsonIgnoreAttribute]
        public override RevitElem? Element
        {
            get => this.FilledRegionType;
            set => this.FilledRegionType = (RevitFilledRegionType?)value;
        }
        public bool IsMasking { get; set; }
        public int LineWeight { get; set; }
        public ColorModel? BackgroundPatternColor { get; set; }
        public FillPatternModel? BackgroundPattern {  get; set; }
        public ColorModel? ForegroundPatternColor { get; set; }
        public FillPatternModel? ForegroundPattern { get; set; }
        #endregion
        #region Public Constructors
        public FilledRegionTypeModel () : base () { }
        public FilledRegionTypeModel (RevitFilledRegionType regionType, bool IsTemplate) : base (regionType, IsTemplate)
        {
            RevitDoc document = regionType.Document;
            this._ApplyProperties(regionType, document);
        }
        public FilledRegionTypeModel (ElementTypeModel serialElementType, bool IsTemplate) : base (serialElementType.ElementType, IsTemplate) 
        {
            if (serialElementType.Element is RevitFilledRegionType || (serialElementType.Element == null && serialElementType.Class == typeof(RevitFilledRegionType).FullName))
            {
                RevitDoc? document = serialElementType.Document;
                if (serialElementType.Element == null && document != null)
                {
                    this.FilledRegionType = serialElementType.GetRevitElem(document) as RevitFilledRegionType;
                }
                if (this.FilledRegionType != null)
                {
                    this._ApplyProperties(this.FilledRegionType, document);
                }
            }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Helper Constructor Functions
        private void _ApplyProperties(RevitFilledRegionType regionType, RevitDoc? document)
        {
            if (document == null) return;
            this.IsMasking = regionType.IsMasking;
            this.LineWeight = regionType.LineWeight;
            this.BackgroundPatternColor = new ColorModel(regionType.BackgroundPatternColor);
            this.ForegroundPatternColor = new ColorModel(regionType.ForegroundPatternColor);
            RevitDB.FillPatternElement bpElem = (RevitDB.FillPatternElement) document.GetElement(regionType.BackgroundPatternId);
            RevitDB.FillPattern backgoundPattern = bpElem.GetFillPattern();
            if (backgoundPattern != null) { this.BackgroundPattern = new FillPatternModel(backgoundPattern); }
            RevitDB.FillPatternElement fpElem = (RevitDB.FillPatternElement)document.GetElement(regionType.ForegroundPatternId);
            RevitDB.FillPattern foregoundPattern = fpElem.GetFillPattern();
            if (foregoundPattern != null) { this.ForegroundPattern = new FillPatternModel(foregoundPattern); }
        }
        #endregion
        #region Public Methods
        RevitDB.FilledRegionType? ToFillRegionType(RevitDoc document)
        {
            RevitDB.FilledRegionType? filledRegionType = FilledRegionTypeModel.CreateElementType(this, document) as RevitDB.FilledRegionType;
            if (filledRegionType != null)
            {
                if (this.BackgroundPatternColor != null)
                {
                    filledRegionType.BackgroundPatternColor = this.BackgroundPatternColor.ToColor();
                }
                if (this.ForegroundPatternColor != null)
                {
                    filledRegionType.ForegroundPatternColor = this.ForegroundPatternColor.ToColor();
                }
                if (this.BackgroundPattern != null)
                {
                    RevitDB.FillPatternElement bpElem = this.BackgroundPattern.ToFillPatternElement(document);
                    if (bpElem != null && bpElem.GetFillPattern().Target == FillPatternTarget.Drafting)
                    {
                        filledRegionType.BackgroundPatternId = bpElem.Id;
                    }
                    else { filledRegionType.BackgroundPatternId = RevitDB.ElementId.InvalidElementId; }
                }
                if (this.ForegroundPattern != null)
                {
                    RevitDB.FillPatternElement fpElem = this.ForegroundPattern.ToFillPatternElement(document);
                    if (fpElem != null) { filledRegionType.ForegroundPatternId = fpElem.Id; }
                    else { filledRegionType.ForegroundPatternId = RevitDB.ElementId.InvalidElementId; }
                }
            }
            return filledRegionType;
        }
        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using RevitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Converters;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
using Synthetic.Shared.RevitAPI;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class FillPatternModel : ObjectModel
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonConverter(typeof(StringEnumConverter))]
        public FillPatternTarget Target { get; set; }
        [JsonConverter(typeof(StringEnumConverter))]
        public FillPatternHostOrientation HostOrientation { get; set; }
        public List<FillGridModel> FillGrids {  get; set; } = new List<FillGridModel>();               
        public FillPatternModel() { }
        public FillPatternModel (string name, FillPatternTarget target, FillPatternHostOrientation orientation, List<FillGridModel> fillgrids)
        {
            this.Name = name;
            this.Target = target;
            this.HostOrientation = orientation;
            this.FillGrids = fillgrids;
        }
        public FillPatternModel (RevitDB.FillPattern pattern)
        {
            if (pattern.IsValidObject)
            {
                this.Name = pattern.Name;
                this.Target = pattern.Target;
                this.HostOrientation = pattern.HostOrientation;
                List<FillGridModel> FillGrids = new List<FillGridModel>();
                IList<RevitDB.FillGrid> grids = pattern.GetFillGrids();
                foreach(RevitDB.FillGrid grid in grids)
                {
                    FillGrids.Add(new FillGridModel(grid));
                }
                this.FillGrids = FillGrids;
            }
        }
        public static FillPatternModel ByJSON (string JSON)
        {
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<FillPatternModel>(JSON)!;
        }
        public static string ToJSON (FillPatternModel fillPatternModel)
        {
            return Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(fillPatternModel, Formatting.Indented);
        }
        public RevitDB.FillPattern ToFillPattern ()
        {
            RevitDB.FillPattern fillPattern = new RevitDB.FillPattern(this.Name, this.Target, this.HostOrientation);
            IList<FillGrid> fillgrids = new List<FillGrid>();
            foreach(FillGridModel grid in this.FillGrids)
            {
                fillgrids.Add(grid.ToFillGrid());
            }
            if (fillgrids.Count > 0)
            {
                fillPattern.SetFillGrids(fillgrids);
            }
            return fillPattern;
        }
        public RevitDB.FillPatternElement ToFillPatternElement (RevitDoc document)
        {
            RevitDB.FillPattern fillPattern = this.ToFillPattern();
            RevitDB.FillPatternElement fillPatternElement = FillPatternElement.Create(document, fillPattern);
            return fillPatternElement;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using revitDB = Autodesk.Revit.DB;
using RevitDoc = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document;
using revitElem = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Element;
using revitElemId = Autodesk.Revit.DB.ElementId;
using revitMaterial = Autodesk.Revit.DB.Material;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM
{
    public class ListModel : ObjectModel
    {
        public List<ElementModel> Elements { get; set; }
        public ListModel()
        {
            this.Elements = new List<ElementModel>();
        }
        public ListModel(List<ElementModel> ElementJSONs)
        {
            this.Elements = ElementJSONs;
        }
        public ListModel(List<revitElem> elements, bool IsTemplate)
        {
            this.Elements = new List<ElementModel>();
            foreach (revitElem elem in elements)
            {
                Elements.Add(new ElementModel(elem, IsTemplate));
            }
        }
        public static ListModel ByJSON(string JSON)
        {
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ListModel>(JSON) ?? new ListModel();
        }
        public static string ToJSON(ListModel ListJSON)
        {
            return Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(ListJSON, Formatting.Indented);
        }
        public static List<revitElem> ModifyElements(ListModel ListJSON, RevitDoc doc)
        {
            List<revitElem> elems = new List<revitElem>();
            foreach (ElementModel e in ListJSON.Elements)
            {
                revitElem? elem = ElementModel.ModifyElement(e, doc);
                if (elem != null)
                {
                    elems.Add(elem);
                }
            }
            return elems;
        }
        public override string ToString()
        {
            return string.Format("{0}(Count=\"{1}\")", this.GetType().Name, this.Elements.Count());
        }
    }
    public class ListMaterialModel : ListModel
    {
        new public List<MaterialModel> Elements { get; set; }
        [JsonConstructor]
        public ListMaterialModel(List<MaterialModel> MaterialJSONs) : base()
        {
            this.Elements = MaterialJSONs;
        }
        public ListMaterialModel(List<revitMaterial> materials, bool IsTemplate)
        {
            this.Elements = new List<MaterialModel>();
            foreach (revitMaterial mat in materials)
            {
                Elements.Add(new MaterialModel(mat, IsTemplate));
            }
        }
        public ListMaterialModel()
        {
            this.Elements = new List<MaterialModel>();
        }
        public new static ListMaterialModel ByJSON(string JSON)
        {
            ListMaterialModel? materials = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ListMaterialModel>(JSON);
            return materials ?? new ListMaterialModel();
        }
        public static string ToJSON(ListMaterialModel ListJSON)
        {
            return Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(ListJSON, Formatting.Indented);
        }
        public static List<revitElem> ModifyElements(ListMaterialModel listMaterialJSON, RevitDoc doc)
        {
            List<revitElem> elems = new List<revitElem>();
            foreach (MaterialModel m in listMaterialJSON.Elements)
            {
                revitElem? elem = MaterialModel.ModifyMaterial(m, doc);
                if (elem != null)
                {
                    elems.Add(elem);

            }

        }

        {
            return string.Format("{0}(Count=\"{1}\")", this.GetType().Name, this.Elements.Count());
```

```csharp
            this.SurfaceBackgroundPatternColor = new ColorModel(material.SurfaceBackgroundPatternColor);

        {

            this.SurfaceForegroundPatternId = new ElementIdModel(material.SurfaceForegroundPatternId, document, this.IsTemplate);

            if (mat == null)
            {
                RevitDB.ElementId matId = RevitMaterial.Create(document, serialMaterial.Name);
                mat = (RevitMaterial)document.GetElement(matId);
```

```csharp
        public FillPatternModel? Pattern { get; set; }
        public FillPatternElementModel() : base() { }
        public FillPatternElementModel(FillPatternElement elem, bool isTemplate) : base(elem, isTemplate)
        {
            if (elem != null && elem.IsValidObject)
            {
                var fp = elem.GetFillPattern();
                if (fp != null)
                {
                    this.Pattern = new FillPatternModel(fp);
                }
            }
        }
public static FillPatternElement? ModifyFillPatternElement(FillPatternElementModel model, Document doc)
        {
            FillPatternElement? elem = model.GetRevitElem(doc) as FillPatternElement;
            if (elem == null)
            {
                if (model.Pattern != null)
                {
                    elem = model.Pattern.ToFillPatternElement(doc);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                elem.Name = model.Name;
                if (model.Pattern != null)
                {
                    elem.SetFillPattern(model.Pattern.ToFillPattern());
                }
            }
            return elem;
        }
    }
    public class LinePatternSegmentModel
    {

        public double Length { get; set; }
    }
    public class LinePatternElementModel : ElementModel
    {
        public List<LinePatternSegmentModel> Segments { get; set; } = new List<LinePatternSegmentModel>();
        public LinePatternElementModel() : base() { }
        public LinePatternElementModel(LinePatternElement elem, bool isTemplate) : base(elem, isTemplate)
        {
            if (elem != null && elem.IsValidObject)
            {
                var lp = elem.GetLinePattern();
                if (lp != null)
                {
                    this.Segments = lp.GetSegments().Select(s => new LinePatternSegmentModel
                    {
                        Type = s.Type.ToString(),
                        Length = s.Length
                    }).ToList();
                }
            }
        }
public static LinePatternElement? ModifyLinePatternElement(LinePatternElementModel model, Document doc)
        {
            LinePatternElement? elem = model.GetRevitElem(doc) as LinePatternElement;
            if (elem == null)
            {
                var lp = new LinePattern(model.Name);
                if (model.Segments != null)
                {
                    var segments = model.Segments.Select(s => new LinePatternSegment(
                        (LinePatternSegmentType)Enum.Parse(typeof(LinePatternSegmentType), s.Type),
                        s.Length
                    )).ToList();
                    lp.SetSegments(segments);
                }
                elem = LinePatternElement.Create(doc, lp);
            }
            else
            {
                elem.Name = model.Name;
                if (model.Segments != null)
                {
                    var lp = new LinePattern(model.Name);
                    var segments = model.Segments.Select(s => new LinePatternSegment(
                        (LinePatternSegmentType)Enum.Parse(typeof(LinePatternSegmentType), s.Type),
                        s.Length
                    )).ToList();
                    lp.SetSegments(segments);
                    elem.SetLinePattern(lp);
                }
            }
            return elem;
        }
    }
    public class PropertySetElementModel : ElementModel
    {
        public PropertySetElementModel() : base() { }
        public PropertySetElementModel(PropertySetElement elem, bool isTemplate) : base(elem, isTemplate) { }
public static PropertySetElement? ModifyPropertySetElement(PropertySetElementModel model, Document doc)
        {
            PropertySetElement? elem = model.GetRevitElem(doc) as PropertySetElement;
            if (elem == null)
            {
                PropertySetElement? template = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                    .OfClass(typeof(PropertySetElement))
                    .Cast<PropertySetElement>()
                    .FirstOrDefault();
                if (template != null)
                {
                    elem = template.Duplicate(doc, model.Name);
                }
                else
                {
                    StructuralAsset asset = new StructuralAsset(model.Name, StructuralAssetClass.Generic);
                    elem = PropertySetElement.Create(doc, asset);
                }
            }
            if (elem != null)
            {
                elem.Name = model.Name;
                foreach (ParameterModel paramJson in model.Parameters)
                {
                    ParameterModel.ModifyParameter(paramJson, elem);
                }
            }
            return elem;
        }
    }
```

```csharp
                        }
                    }
                    foreach (var key in keysToMigrate)
                    {
                        var elemType = this.ElementTypes[key];
                        this.ElementTypes.Remove(key);
                        if (elemType.Name != null && !this.TextElementTypes.ContainsKey(elemType.Name))
                        {
                            this.TextElementTypes.Add(elemType.Name, elemType);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
            }
        }

        private static ElementModel? _serialByType(RevitElem revitElement, bool IsTemplate)
        {
            ElementModel? serializeElement = null;
            if (revitElement is FilledRegionType fillRegionType)

            else if (revitElement is RevitMaterial material)

            else if (revitElement is RevitDimType dimType)

                if (dimType.Name != DimensionTypeModel.InternalDimStyleName)

                    serializeElement = new DimensionTypeModel(dimType, IsTemplate);

            else if (revitElement is CurtainSystemType curtainSystemType)
            {
                serializeElement = new CurtainSystemTypeModel(curtainSystemType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is RevitHostObjType hostObjType)
            {
                serializeElement = new HostObjTypeModel(hostObjType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is RevitView view)
            {
                serializeElement = new ViewModel(view, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is GridType gridType)
            {
                serializeElement = new GridTypeModel(gridType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is LevelType levelType)
            {
                serializeElement = new LevelTypeModel(levelType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is MullionType mullionType)
            {
                serializeElement = new MullionTypeModel(mullionType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is FasciaType fasciaType)
            {
                serializeElement = new FasciaTypeModel(fasciaType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is GutterType gutterType)
            {
                serializeElement = new GutterTypeModel(gutterType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is ViewFamilyType viewFamilyType)
            {
                serializeElement = new ViewFamilyTypeModel(viewFamilyType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is RevitElemType elemType)
            {
                serializeElement = new ElementTypeModel(elemType, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is FillPatternElement fillPatternElement)
            {
                serializeElement = new FillPatternElementModel(fillPatternElement, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is LinePatternElement linePatternElement)
            {
                serializeElement = new LinePatternElementModel(linePatternElement, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is PropertySetElement propertySetElement)
            {
                serializeElement = new PropertySetElementModel(propertySetElement, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is BrowserOrganization browserOrganization)
            {
                serializeElement = new BrowserOrganizationModel(browserOrganization, IsTemplate);
            }
            else if (revitElement is ParameterElement parameterElement)
            {
                serializeElement = new ParameterElementModel(parameterElement, IsTemplate);
            }
            else
            {
                serializeElement = new ElementModel(revitElement, IsTemplate);
            }
            return serializeElement;
        }
```
