        private void ExecuteBrowse(object obj)
        {
            OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "JSON Files (*.json)|*.json|All Files (*.*)|*.*",
                Title = "Select Serialized Styles JSON File"
            };
            if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                FilePath = openFileDialog.FileName;
            }
        }
        private List<ElementModel> FilterStyles(List<ElementModel> styles)
        {
            var filtered = new List<ElementModel>();
            foreach (var style in styles)
            {
                string className = style.Class;
                if (style is CategoryModel cat)
                {
                    string group1 = cat.CategoryGroupLevel1;
                    if (group1 == "Annotation Categories" && !ClassSelection.ExportAnnotationCategories) continue;
                    if (group1 == "Model Categories" && !ClassSelection.ExportModelCategories) continue;
                    if (group1 == "Analytical Categories" && !ClassSelection.ExportAnalyticalCategories) continue;
                    if (group1 == "Imported Categories" && !ClassSelection.ExportImportCategories) continue;
                    if (group1 == "Line Styles" && !ClassSelection.ExportLineStyles) continue;
                }
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.GridType" && !ClassSelection.ExportGridTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.LevelType" && !ClassSelection.ExportLevelTypes) continue;
                if ((className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.TextNoteType" || className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.TextElementType") && !ClassSelection.ExportTextNoteTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.LabelType" && !ClassSelection.ExportLabelTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.DimensionType" && !ClassSelection.ExportDimensionTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.FilledRegionType" && !ClassSelection.ExportFilledRegionTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.Material" && !ClassSelection.ExportMaterials) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.FillPatternElement" && !ClassSelection.ExportFillPatterns) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.LinePatternElement" && !ClassSelection.ExportLinePatterns) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.PropertySetElement" && !ClassSelection.ExportAppearanceAssets) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.WallType" && !ClassSelection.ExportWallTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.FloorType" && !ClassSelection.ExportFloorTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.RoofType" && !ClassSelection.ExportRoofTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.CeilingType" && !ClassSelection.ExportCeilingTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.RailingType" && !ClassSelection.ExportRailingTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.StairsType" && !ClassSelection.ExportStairsTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.CurtainSystemType" && !ClassSelection.ExportCurtainSystemTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.MullionType" && !ClassSelection.ExportMullionTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.FasciaType" && !ClassSelection.ExportFasciaTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.GutterType" && !ClassSelection.ExportGutterTypes) continue;
                if (style is ViewModel vm)
                {
                    if (vm.IsTemplate && !ClassSelection.ExportViewTemplates) continue;
                    if (!vm.IsTemplate && !ClassSelection.ExportStandardViews) continue;
                }
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.ViewFamilyType" && !ClassSelection.ExportViewFamilyTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.BrowserOrganization" && !ClassSelection.ExportBrowserOrganizations) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.FamilySymbol" && style.Category == "Title Blocks" && !ClassSelection.ExportTitleBlockTypes) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.ParameterElement" && !ClassSelection.ExportParameterElements) continue;
                if (className == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.LineStyle" && !ClassSelection.ExportLineStyles) continue;
                filtered.Add(style);
            }
            return filtered;
        }
        private void ExecuteAnalyze(object obj)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Jrn.Directive \"SyntheticQA\", \"EnforceStandards_Action: Analyze\"");
            var settings = SettingsManager.Get<StandardsSettings>(_doc) ?? new StandardsSettings();
            if (settings.StandardsFilePath != FilePath)
            {
                settings.StandardsFilePath = FilePath;
                SettingsManager.Save(_doc, settings);
                Console.WriteLine("Jrn.Directive \"SyntheticQA\", \"SettingsSaved: StandardsFilePath\"");
            }
            IsProcessing = true;
            try
            {
                List<ElementModel> styleTypes;
                if (_inMemoryStyles != null)
                {
                    styleTypes = _inMemoryStyles.ToList();
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!File.Exists(FilePath))
                    {
                        MessageBox.Show("Selected JSON file does not exist.", "File Not Found", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                        return;
                    }
                    string json = File.ReadAllText(FilePath);
                    IEnumerable<ElementModel> standards = ModelsToSerialize.DeserializeByJson(json);
                    styleTypes = standards.ToList();
                }
                List<ElementModel> filteredStyles = FilterStyles(styleTypes);
                var clusters = StandardsDiffEngine.RunDeepScan(_doc, filteredStyles);
                var reviewVM = new StandardsReviewViewModel(_doc, clusters);
                var reviewWindow = new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views.StandardsReviewWindow(_uiapp.MainWindowHandle) { DataContext = reviewVM };
                bool? result = reviewWindow.ShowDialog();
                if (result == true)
                {
                    CloseAction?.Invoke();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show($"An error occurred during standards analysis:\n{ex.Message}", "Analysis Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                IsProcessing = false;
            }
        }
        private void ExecuteEnforce(object obj)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Jrn.Directive \"SyntheticQA\", \"EnforceStandards_Action: EnforceSilent\"");
            var settings = SettingsManager.Get<StandardsSettings>(_doc) ?? new StandardsSettings();
            if (settings.StandardsFilePath != FilePath)
            {
                settings.StandardsFilePath = FilePath;
                SettingsManager.Save(_doc, settings);
                Console.WriteLine("Jrn.Directive \"SyntheticQA\", \"SettingsSaved: StandardsFilePath\"");
            }
            IsProcessing = true;
            var ownerWindow = System.Windows.Application.Current.Windows.OfType<Window>().FirstOrDefault(w => w.DataContext == this && w.IsVisible);
            ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Import Styles", _inMemoryStyles != null ? "Preparing in-memory style models..." : "Reading JSON standards file...", 100);
            if (ownerWindow != null)
            {
                ownerWindow.IsEnabled = false;
            }
            var tracker = new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ObservableCollection<Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem>();
            try
            {
                List<ElementModel> styleTypes;
                if (_inMemoryStyles != null)
                {
                    styleTypes = _inMemoryStyles.ToList();
                }
                else
                {
                    string json = File.ReadAllText(FilePath);
                    IEnumerable<ElementModel> standards = ModelsToSerialize.DeserializeByJson(json);
                    styleTypes = standards.ToList();
                }
                List<ElementModel> filteredStyles = FilterStyles(styleTypes);
                if (filteredStyles.Count == 0)
                {
                    ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                    if (ownerWindow != null)
                    {
                        ownerWindow.IsEnabled = true;
                    }
                    MessageBox.Show("No valid style objects matched the selected filters.", "No Styles Matched", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    StatusMessage = "Import failed. No matching styles found.";
                    return;
                }
                if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                {
                    foreach (var s in filteredStyles)
                    {
                        tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = "Canceled", Class = s.Class, ElementName = s.Name, Message = "Import cancelled by user." });
                    }
                    throw new OperationCanceledException();
                }
                ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Import Styles", $"Importing {filteredStyles.Count} styles into project...", filteredStyles.Count);
                using (TransactionGroup tg = new TransactionGroup(_doc, "Enforce Project Standards"))
                {
                    tg.Start();
                    foreach (ElementModel serialElement in filteredStyles)
                    {
                        if (serialElement is ElementTypeModel etModel)
                        {
                            etModel.ElementType = null;
                        }
                        serialElement.Element = null;
                        serialElement.Document = null;
                    }
                    int currentIndex = 0;
                    foreach (ElementModel serialElement in filteredStyles)
                    {
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                    {
                        tg.RollBack();
                        for (int i = currentIndex; i < filteredStyles.Count; i++)
                        {
                            tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = "Canceled", Class = filteredStyles[i].Class, ElementName = filteredStyles[i].Name, Message = "Import cancelled by user." });
                        }
                        throw new OperationCanceledException();
                    }
                        currentIndex++;
                        string action = "Updated";
                        string? message = "Updated style element parameters.";
                        try
                        {
                            bool hasAliasMatch = false;
                            string? aliasMessage = null;
                            bool exists = false;
                            if (serialElement is CategoryModel catModel)
                            {
                                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(catModel.ParentCategoryName))
                                {
                                    Category? parentCategory = _doc.Settings.Categories
                                        .Cast<Category>()
                                        .FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name.Equals(catModel.ParentCategoryName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                                    if (parentCategory != null)
                                    {
                                        exists = parentCategory.SubCategories
                                            .Cast<Category>()
                                            .Any(c => c.Name.Equals(catModel.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    exists = _doc.Settings.Categories
                                        .Cast<Category>()
                                        .Any(c => c.Name.Equals(catModel.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                 System.Reflection.Assembly assembly = typeof(Element).Assembly;
                                 Type? elemClass = null;
                                 string? serialClass = serialElement.Class;
                                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(serialClass))
                                 {
                                     elemClass = assembly.GetType(serialClass);
                                     if (elemClass == null && !serialClass!.StartsWith("Autodesk.Revit.DB."))
                                     {
                                         elemClass = assembly.GetType("Autodesk.Revit.DB." + serialClass);
                                     }
                                 }
                                 if (elemClass != null && serialElement.Name != null)
                                 {
                                     Element? standardElem = Select.ElementByNameClass(serialElement.Name, elemClass, _doc);
                                    if (standardElem == null && serialElement.Aliases != null && serialElement.Aliases.Count > 0)
                                    {
                                        foreach (string alias in serialElement.Aliases)
                                        {
                                            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias)) continue;
                                            Element? aliasedElem = Select.ElementByNameClass(alias, elemClass, _doc);
                                            if (aliasedElem != null)
                                            {
                                                hasAliasMatch = true;
                                                aliasMessage = $"Renamed alias '{alias}' to standard '{serialElement.Name}'.";
                                                break;
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                 if (elemClass != null && serialElement.Name != null)
                                 {
                                     exists = (Select.ElementByNameClass(serialElement.Name, elemClass, _doc) != null);
                                 }
                            }
                            if (hasAliasMatch)
                            {
                                action = "Renamed";
                                message = aliasMessage;
                            }
                            else if (!exists)
                            {
                                action = "Created";
                                message = "Created new style element.";
                            }
                            ModelsToSerialize.ResolveAndRenameAliases(serialElement, _doc, MergeAliases);
                            if (serialElement is MaterialModel matModel)
                            {
                                MaterialModel.CreateMaterial(matModel, _doc);
                            }
                            else if (serialElement is ViewModel viewModel)
                            {
                                ModelsToSerialize.ModifyElement(viewModel, _doc);
                            }
                            else if (serialElement is ElementTypeModel etModel)
                            {
                                ModelsToSerialize.CreateElementType(etModel, _doc);
                                if (MergeAliases)
                                {
                                    ElementTypeModel.MergeAliasTypes(etModel, _doc);
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                ModelsToSerialize.ModifyElement(serialElement, _doc);
                            }
                            tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = action, Class = serialElement.Class ?? string.Empty, ElementName = serialElement.Name ?? string.Empty, Message = message ?? string.Empty });
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = "Failed", Class = serialElement.Class ?? string.Empty, ElementName = serialElement.Name ?? string.Empty, Message = ex.Message });
                        }
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateProgress(serialElement.Name ?? "Style Element");
                    }
                    tg.Assimilate();
                }
                if (UpdateFamilies)
                {
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                    {
                        throw new OperationCanceledException();
                    }
                    ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                    ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Import Styles", "Collecting families to update...", 100);
                    IList<Family> allFamilies = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                        .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                        .Cast<Family>()
                        .ToList();
                    var checkedCategoryIds = ClassSelection.GetCheckedCategoryIds();
                    List<Family> familiesToProcess = new List<Family>();
                    foreach (Family family in allFamilies)
                    {
                        if (family.IsEditable)
                        {
                            if (SelectedCategoryFilter == "Annotations Only" && (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.CategoryType != CategoryType.Annotation))
                                continue;
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                            if (SelectedCategoryFilter == "Title Blocks Only" && (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id.IntegerValue != (int)BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks))
#else
                            if (SelectedCategoryFilter == "Title Blocks Only" && (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id.Value != (long)BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks))
#endif
                                continue;
                            if (checkedCategoryIds.Any() && family.FamilyCategory != null && !checkedCategoryIds.Contains(family.FamilyCategory.Id))
                                continue;
                            familiesToProcess.Add(family);
                        }
                    }
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                    {
                        throw new OperationCanceledException();
                    }
                    if (_doc.IsWorkshared && familiesToProcess.Count > 0)
                    {
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus("Checking out family worksets...");
                        List<WorksetId> worksetIds = familiesToProcess
                            .Select(f => f.WorksetId)
                            .Distinct()
                            .Where(id => id != WorksetId.InvalidWorksetId)
                            .ToList();
                        if (worksetIds.Count > 0)
                        {
                            WorksharingUtils.CheckoutWorksets(_doc, worksetIds);
                        }
                    }
                    List<string> familyNamesToProcess = familiesToProcess
                        .Select(f => f.Name)
                        .Distinct()
                        .ToList();
                    ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                    ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Import Styles - Families", "Updating families...", familyNamesToProcess.Count);
                    int familyIndex = 0;
                    foreach (string familyName in familyNamesToProcess)
                    {
                        if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                        {
                            for (int i = familyIndex; i < familyNamesToProcess.Count; i++)
                            {
                                tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = "Canceled", Class = "Family", ElementName = familyNamesToProcess[i], Message = "Cancelled by user." });
                            }
                            throw new OperationCanceledException();
                        }
                        familyIndex++;
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus($"Updating family {familyIndex} of {familyNamesToProcess.Count}: {familyName}...");
                        try
                        {
                            Family? family = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                                .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                                .Cast<Family>()
                                .FirstOrDefault(f => f.Name == familyName);
                            if (family != null && family.IsValidObject)
                            {
                                UpdateFamilyRecursively(_doc, family, filteredStyles);
                                tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = "Updated", Class = "Family", ElementName = familyName, Message = "Successfully updated style types in family." });
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            tracker.Add(new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Models.ImportLogItem { Action = "Failed", Class = "Family", ElementName = familyName, Message = ex.Message });
                        }
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateProgress(familyName);
                    }
                }
                ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                if (ownerWindow != null)
                {
                    ownerWindow.IsEnabled = true;
                }
                var summaryVM = new ImportSummaryViewModel(tracker);
                var summaryWindow = new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views.ImportSummaryWindow(_uiapp.MainWindowHandle, summaryVM);
                summaryWindow.ShowDialog();
                CloseAction?.Invoke();
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                if (ownerWindow != null)
                {
                    ownerWindow.IsEnabled = true;
                }
                var summaryVM = new ImportSummaryViewModel(tracker);
                var summaryWindow = new Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views.ImportSummaryWindow(_uiapp.MainWindowHandle, summaryVM);
                summaryWindow.ShowDialog();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                if (ownerWindow != null)
                {
                    ownerWindow.IsEnabled = true;
                }
                MessageBox.Show($"An error occurred during style import:\n{ex.Message}", "Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
                StatusMessage = "Import failed due to error.";
            }
            finally
            {
                IsProcessing = false;
            }
        }
        private void UpdateFamilyRecursively(
            Document parentDoc, 
            Family family, 
            IEnumerable<ElementModel> standards)
        {
            if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
            if (family == null || !family.IsEditable) return;
            Document? familyDoc = null;
            try
            {
                familyDoc = parentDoc.EditFamily(family);
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return;
            }
            if (familyDoc == null) return;
            try
            {
                if (ProcessNested)
                {
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
                    IList<Family> nestedFamilies = new FilteredElementCollector(familyDoc)
                        .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                        .Cast<Family>()
                        .ToList();
                    var nestedFamiliesInfo = nestedFamilies
                        .Select(nf => new { Id = nf.Id, Name = nf.Name, IsEditable = nf.IsEditable })
                        .ToList();
                    foreach (var nfInfo in nestedFamiliesInfo)
                    {
                        if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
                        if (nfInfo.IsEditable)
                        {
                            Family? freshNestedFamily = new FilteredElementCollector(familyDoc)
                                .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                                .Cast<Family>()
                                .FirstOrDefault(nf => nf.Name == nfInfo.Name);
                            if (freshNestedFamily != null && freshNestedFamily.IsValidObject)
                            {
                                UpdateFamilyRecursively(familyDoc, freshNestedFamily, standards);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
                foreach (ElementModel serialElement in standards)
                {
                    if (serialElement is ElementTypeModel etModel)
                    {
                        etModel.ElementType = null;
                    }
                    serialElement.Element = null;
                    serialElement.Document = null;
                }
                using (TransactionGroup tg = new TransactionGroup(familyDoc, "Update Styles in Family"))
                {
                    tg.Start();
                    foreach (ElementModel serialElement in standards)
                    {
                        if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                        {
                            tg.RollBack();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (serialElement is MaterialModel matModel)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                MaterialModel.CreateMaterial(matModel, familyDoc);
                            }
                            catch (Exception)
                            {
                            }
                        }
                        else if (serialElement is ElementTypeModel etModel)
                        {
                            if (familyDoc.IsFamilyDocument && etModel.Class == "Autodesk.Revit.DB.SpotDimensionType")
                            {
                                continue;
                            }
                            try
                            {
                                ModelsToSerialize.CreateElementType(etModel, familyDoc);
                            }
                            catch (Exception)
                            {
                            }
                            if (MergeAliases)
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    ElementTypeModel.MergeAliasTypes(etModel, familyDoc);
                                }
                                catch (Exception)
                                {
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
#if !REVIT2022
                    if (PurgeUnused)
                    {
                        if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                        {
                            tg.RollBack();
                            return;
                        }
                        try
                        {
                            DocumentUtil.Purge(parentDoc.Application, familyDoc);
                        }
                        catch (Exception)
                        {
                        }
                    }
#endif
                    tg.Assimilate();
                }
                try
                {
                    SFamilyUtil.SetIsChanged(parentDoc, familyDoc);
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                }
                try
                {
                    familyDoc.LoadFamily(parentDoc, new ImportFamilyLoadOptions());
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    throw;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    familyDoc.Close(false);
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                }
            }
        }
        private void ExecuteCancel(object obj)
        {
            CloseAction?.Invoke();
        }
        private void AllowUIToUpdate()
        {
            var dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher ?? System.Windows.Threading.Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher;
            dispatcher.Invoke(System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Background, new Action(delegate { }));
        }
        private class ImportFamilyLoadOptions : IFamilyLoadOptions
        {
            public bool OnFamilyFound(bool familyInUse, out bool overwriteParameterValues)
            {
                overwriteParameterValues = true;
                return true;
            }
            public bool OnSharedFamilyFound(Family sharedFamily, bool familyInUse, out FamilySource source, out bool overwriteParameterValues)
            {
                source = FamilySource.Family;
                overwriteParameterValues = true;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
}
