        public ExportStylesViewModel(UIApplication uiapp) : this(uiapp, false)
        {
        }
        public ExportStylesViewModel(UIApplication uiapp, bool isInMemoryMode)
        {
            _uiapp = uiapp;
            _doc = uiapp.ActiveUIDocument.Document;
            _isInMemoryMode = isInMemoryMode;
            CategorySelection = new CategorySelectionViewModel(_doc);
            ClassSelection = new StandardsClassSelectionViewModel(_doc);
            _groupedCartView = System.Windows.Data.CollectionViewSource.GetDefaultView(CartItems);
            _groupedCartView.GroupDescriptions.Add(new System.Windows.Data.PropertyGroupDescription(nameof(ElementTypeWrapperVM.Group)));
            _groupedCartView.GroupDescriptions.Add(new System.Windows.Data.PropertyGroupDescription(nameof(ElementTypeWrapperVM.Class)));
            if (_groupedCartView is System.Windows.Data.ListCollectionView listColView)
            {
                listColView.CustomSort = new ElementTypeWrapperComparer();
            }
            BrowseCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteBrowse, _ => !IsProcessing);
            ExportCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteExport, _ => CanExport());
            CancelCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteCancel, _ => !IsProcessing);
            AddAnnotationsCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddAnnotations());
            AddViewsCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddViews());
            AddModelSystemTypesCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddModelSystemTypes());
            AddFamilyTypesCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddFamilyTypes());
            AddMaterialsCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddMaterials());
            AddCategoriesCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddCategories());
            AddElementsCommand = new RelayCommand(_ => AddElements());
            RemoveCartItemCommand = new RelayCommand(item => RemoveCartItem(item));
        }
        private bool CanExport()
        {
            if (_isInMemoryMode)
            {
                return !IsProcessing;
            }
            return !IsProcessing && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ExportFilePath);
        }
        private void ExecuteBrowse(object obj)
        {
            SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "JSON Files (*.json)|*.json|All Files (*.*)|*.*",
                Title = "Select Export Destination File Path",
                FileName = "Standards AnnotationTypes.json"
            };
            if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                ExportFilePath = saveFileDialog.FileName;
            }
        }
        private void ExecuteExport(object obj)
        {
            IsProcessing = true;
            var ownerWindow = System.Windows.Application.Current.Windows.OfType<Window>().FirstOrDefault(w => w.DataContext == this && w.IsVisible);
            ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Export Styles", "Starting style export...", 100);
            if (ownerWindow != null)
            {
                ownerWindow.IsEnabled = false;
            }
            try
            {
                List<ObjectModel> exportedStyles = new List<ObjectModel>();
                HashSet<string> uniqueKeys = new HashSet<string>();
                var selectedSystemClasses = new List<Type>();
                if (ClassSelection.ExportTextNoteTypes)
                {
                    selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(TextNoteType));
                    selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(TextElementType));
                }
                if (ClassSelection.ExportDimensionTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(DimensionType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportFilledRegionTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(FilledRegionType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportMaterials) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(Material));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportWallTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(WallType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportFloorTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(FloorType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportRoofTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(RoofType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportCeilingTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(CeilingType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportRailingTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture.RailingType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportStairsTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture.StairsType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportStandardViews || ClassSelection.ExportViewTemplates) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.View));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportGridTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(GridType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportLevelTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(LevelType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportFillPatterns) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(FillPatternElement));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportLinePatterns) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(LinePatternElement));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportAppearanceAssets) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(PropertySetElement));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportCurtainSystemTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(CurtainSystemType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportMullionTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(MullionType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportFasciaTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(FasciaType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportGutterTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(GutterType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportViewFamilyTypes) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(ViewFamilyType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportBrowserOrganizations) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(BrowserOrganization));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportParameterElements) selectedSystemClasses.Add(typeof(ParameterElement));
                var checkedCategoryIds = ClassSelection.GetCheckedCategoryIds();
                bool hasClassSelection = selectedSystemClasses.Any() 
                    || checkedCategoryIds.Any() 
                    || ClassSelection.ExportLineStyles
                    || ClassSelection.ExportModelCategories
                    || ClassSelection.ExportAnnotationCategories
                    || ClassSelection.ExportAnalyticalCategories
                    || ClassSelection.ExportImportCategories
                    || ClassSelection.ExportTitleBlockTypes
                    || ClassSelection.ExportLabelTypes;
                bool hasCartSelection = SelectedExportItems != null && SelectedExportItems.Any();
                var elementsToProcess = new List<Element>();
                if (hasClassSelection || hasCartSelection)
                {
                    ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus("Exporting selected elements...");
                    var seenIds = new HashSet<ElementId>();
                    if (selectedSystemClasses.Any())
                    {
                        foreach (var cls in selectedSystemClasses)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                var systemElements = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                                    .OfClass(cls)
                                    .ToElements();
                                if (cls == typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.View))
                                {
                                    foreach (Autodesk.Revit.DB.View view in systemElements)
                                    {
                                        if (view.IsTemplate && ClassSelection.ExportViewTemplates)
                                        {
                                            if (!seenIds.Contains(view.Id))
                                            {
                                                seenIds.Add(view.Id);
                                                elementsToProcess.Add(view);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        else if (!view.IsTemplate && ClassSelection.ExportStandardViews)
                                        {
                                            if (!seenIds.Contains(view.Id))
                                            {
                                                seenIds.Add(view.Id);
                                                elementsToProcess.Add(view);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                else if (cls == typeof(TextElementType))
                                {
                                    foreach (var elem in systemElements)
                                    {
                                        if (!(elem is TextNoteType) && !seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                                        {
                                            seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                            elementsToProcess.Add(elem);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    foreach (var elem in systemElements)
                                    {
                                        if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                                        {
                                            seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                            elementsToProcess.Add(elem);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch {}
                        }
                    }
                    if (checkedCategoryIds.Any())
                    {
                        var catFilters = checkedCategoryIds.Select(id => new ElementCategoryFilter(id)).Cast<ElementFilter>().ToList();
                        ElementFilter categoryFilter = catFilters.Count == 1 ? catFilters.First() : new LogicalOrFilter(catFilters);
                        var familySymbols = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                            .OfClass(typeof(FamilySymbol))
                            .WherePasses(categoryFilter)
                            .ToElements();
                        foreach (var elem in familySymbols)
                        {
                            if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                            {
                                seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                elementsToProcess.Add(elem);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (ClassSelection.ExportTitleBlockTypes)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            var titleBlockSymbols = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                                .OfClass(typeof(FamilySymbol))
                                .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
                                .ToElements();
                            foreach (var elem in titleBlockSymbols)
                            {
                                if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                                {
                                    seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                    elementsToProcess.Add(elem);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        catch {}
                    }
                    if (ClassSelection.ExportLabelTypes)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            var labelSymbols = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                                .OfClass(typeof(FamilySymbol))
                                .Cast<FamilySymbol>()
                                .Where(fs => fs.Category != null && fs.Category.CategoryType == CategoryType.Annotation)
                                .Cast<Element>()
                                .ToList();
                            foreach (var elem in labelSymbols)
                            {
                                if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                                {
                                    seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                    elementsToProcess.Add(elem);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        catch {}
                    }
                    if (ClassSelection.ExportLineStyles || ClassSelection.ExportModelCategories || ClassSelection.ExportAnnotationCategories || ClassSelection.ExportAnalyticalCategories || ClassSelection.ExportImportCategories)
                    {
                        Action<Category, Category?>? scrapeCategory = null;
                        scrapeCategory = (c, parentCat) =>
                        {
                            if (c == null) return;
                            try
                            {
                                Category? effectiveParent = parentCat ?? c.Parent;
                                string parentName = effectiveParent != null ? effectiveParent.Name : "";
                                bool isLineStyle = string.Equals(c.Name, "Lines", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || 
                                                   string.Equals(parentName, "Lines", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                                bool isImported = c.Name.StartsWith("Imports in ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || 
                                                  parentName.StartsWith("Imports in ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                                                  c.Name.IndexOf(".dwg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                                                  parentName.IndexOf(".dwg", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
                                bool shouldExport = false;
                                if (isLineStyle)
                                {
                                    shouldExport = ClassSelection.ExportLineStyles;
                                }
                                else if (isImported)
                                {
                                    shouldExport = ClassSelection.ExportImportCategories;
                                }
                                else if (c.CategoryType == CategoryType.Annotation)
                                {
                                    shouldExport = ClassSelection.ExportAnnotationCategories;
                                }
                                else if (c.CategoryType == CategoryType.AnalyticalModel)
                                {
                                    shouldExport = ClassSelection.ExportAnalyticalCategories;
                                }
                                else if (c.CategoryType == CategoryType.Model)
                                {
                                    shouldExport = ClassSelection.ExportModelCategories;
                                }
                                if (shouldExport)
                                {
                                    var categoryModel = ModelsToSerialize.ByCategory(c, _doc, true);
                                    if (categoryModel != null)
                                    {
                                        if (effectiveParent != null)
                                        {
                                            categoryModel.ParentCategoryName = effectiveParent.Name;
                                            categoryModel.CategoryGroupLevel2 = effectiveParent.Name;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            categoryModel.ParentCategoryName = null;
                                            categoryModel.CategoryGroupLevel2 = c.Name;
                                        }
                                        string key = $"Category:[{categoryModel.ParentCategoryName ?? ""}]_{categoryModel.Name}";
                                        if (!uniqueKeys.Contains(key))
                                        {
                                            uniqueKeys.Add(key);
                                            exportedStyles.Add(categoryModel);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch {}
                            try
                            {
                                if (c.SubCategories != null)
                                {
                                    foreach (Category sub in c.SubCategories)
                                    {
                                        scrapeCategory!(sub, parentCat ?? c);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch {}
                        };
                        foreach (Category cat in _doc.Settings.Categories)
                        {
                            if (cat.IsVisibleInUI && cat.Parent == null)
                            {
                                scrapeCategory!(cat, null);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (hasCartSelection)
                    {
                        foreach (var id in SelectedExportItems!)
                        {
                            var elem = _doc.GetElement(id);
                            if (elem != null && !elementsToProcess.Any(e => e.Id == id))
                            {
                                elementsToProcess.Add(elem);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus("Collecting style types from top-level document...");
                    var topStyles = CollectAnnotationStyles(_doc);
                    elementsToProcess.AddRange(topStyles);
                }
                HarvestDependencies(elementsToProcess, _doc);
                ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Export Styles", "Serializing elements...", elementsToProcess.Count);
                foreach (var elem in elementsToProcess)
                {
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                    {
                        StatusMessage = "Export cancelled.";
                        return;
                    }
                    try
                    {
                        var serialModel = ModelsToSerialize.ByElement(elem, true);
                        if (serialModel != null)
                        {
                            string key = "";
                            if (serialModel is CategoryModel catModel)
                            {
                                key = $"Category:[{catModel.ParentCategoryName ?? ""}]_{catModel.Name}";
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                key = $"{serialModel.Class}:{serialModel.Name}";
                            }
                            if (!uniqueKeys.Contains(key))
                            {
                                uniqueKeys.Add(key);
                                exportedStyles.Add(serialModel);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception)
                    {
                    }
                    ProgressCoordinator.UpdateProgress(elem.Name ?? "Style Element");
                }
                bool scanFamiliesForSelection = false;
                List<Type> familyRelevantSystemClasses = new List<Type>();
                if (ClassSelection.ExportTextNoteTypes)
                {
                    familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(TextNoteType));
                    familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(TextElementType));
                }
                if (ClassSelection.ExportDimensionTypes) familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(DimensionType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportFilledRegionTypes) familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(FilledRegionType));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportMaterials) familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(Material));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportFillPatterns) familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(FillPatternElement));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportLinePatterns) familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(LinePatternElement));
                if (ClassSelection.ExportAppearanceAssets) familyRelevantSystemClasses.Add(typeof(PropertySetElement));
                if (ScanFamilies)
                {
                    if (hasClassSelection)
                    {
                        if (familyRelevantSystemClasses.Any() || checkedCategoryIds.Any())
                        {
                            scanFamiliesForSelection = true;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        scanFamiliesForSelection = true;
                    }
                }
                if (scanFamiliesForSelection)
                {
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                    {
                        StatusMessage = "Export cancelled.";
                        return;
                    }
                    ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus("Collecting families to scan...");
                    IList<Family> allFamilies = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                        .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                        .Cast<Family>()
                        .ToList();
                    List<Family> familiesToProcess = new List<Family>();
                    foreach (Family family in allFamilies)
                    {
                        if (family.IsEditable)
                        {
                            if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter != null)
                            {
                                if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Id != ElementId.InvalidElementId)
                                {
                                    if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id != CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Id)
                                    {
                                        continue;
                                    }
                                }
                                else if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Name == "Annotations Only")
                                {
                                    if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.CategoryType != CategoryType.Annotation)
                                        continue;
                                }
                                else if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Name == "Title Blocks Only")
                                {
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                                    if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id.IntegerValue != (int)BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
#else
                                    if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id.Value != (long)BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
#endif
                                        continue;
                                }
                            }
                            if (hasClassSelection)
                            {
                                if (checkedCategoryIds.Any())
                                {
                                    if (family.FamilyCategory == null || !checkedCategoryIds.Contains(family.FamilyCategory.Id))
                                    {
                                        continue;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            familiesToProcess.Add(family);
                        }
                    }
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                    {
                        StatusMessage = "Export cancelled.";
                        return;
                    }
                    if (_doc.IsWorkshared && familiesToProcess.Count > 0)
                    {
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus("Checking out family worksets...");
                        List<WorksetId> worksetIds = familiesToProcess
                            .Select(f => f.WorksetId)
                            .Distinct()
                            .Where(id => id != WorksetId.InvalidWorksetId)
                            .ToList();
                        if (worksetIds.Count > 0)
                        {
                            WorksharingUtils.CheckoutWorksets(_doc, worksetIds);
                        }
                    }
                    List<string> familyNamesToProcess = familiesToProcess
                        .Select(f => f.Name)
                        .Distinct()
                        .ToList();
                    ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                    ProgressCoordinator.Initialize("Export Styles - Families", "Scanning families...", familyNamesToProcess.Count);
                    int familyIndex = 0;
                    foreach (string familyName in familyNamesToProcess)
                    {
                        if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled())
                        {
                            StatusMessage = "Export cancelled.";
                            return;
                        }
                        familyIndex++;
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus($"Scanning family {familyIndex} of {familyNamesToProcess.Count}: {familyName}...");
                        try
                        {
                            Family? family = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                                .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                                .Cast<Family>()
                                .FirstOrDefault(f => f.Name == familyName);
                            if (family != null && family.IsValidObject)
                            {
                                if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter != null)
                                {
                                    if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Id != ElementId.InvalidElementId)
                                    {
                                        if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id != CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Id)
                                        {
                                            continue;
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Name == "Annotations Only")
                                    {
                                        if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.CategoryType != CategoryType.Annotation)
                                            continue;
                                    }
                                    else if (CategorySelection.SelectedCategoryFilter.Name == "Title Blocks Only")
                                    {
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                                        if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id.IntegerValue != (int)BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
#else
                                        if (family.FamilyCategory == null || family.FamilyCategory.Id.Value != (long)BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
#endif
                                            continue;
                                    }
                                }
                                ScanFamilyRecursively(_doc, family, exportedStyles, uniqueKeys, 0, familyName, hasClassSelection, familyRelevantSystemClasses, checkedCategoryIds);
                            }
                        }
                        catch (Exception)
                        {
                        }
                        ProgressCoordinator.UpdateProgress(familyName);
                    }
                }
                if (_isInMemoryMode)
                {
                    _generatedStyles = exportedStyles;
                    StatusMessage = "In-memory extraction complete!";
                    CloseAction?.Invoke();
                    return;
                }
                ProgressCoordinator.UpdateStatus("Serializing styles to JSON...");
                string json = ModelsToSerialize.SerializeToJson(exportedStyles);
                int activeClassCount = ClassSelection.GetType()
                    .GetProperties()
                    .Where(p => p.PropertyType == typeof(bool) && p.Name.StartsWith("Export"))
                    .Count(p => (bool)(p.GetValue(ClassSelection) ?? false));
                Console.WriteLine($"Jrn.Directive \"SyntheticQA\", \"ExportCategoriesCount: [{activeClassCount}]\"");
                File.WriteAllText(ExportFilePath, json);
                MessageBox.Show($"Export complete! Serialized {exportedStyles.Count} style types to:\n{ExportFilePath}", 
                    "Export Success", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
                CloseAction?.Invoke();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show($"An error occurred during export:\n{ex.Message}\n\nStack Trace:\n{ex.StackTrace}", 
                    "Export Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                ProgressCoordinator.Close();
                if (ownerWindow != null)
                {
                    try { ownerWindow.IsEnabled = true; ownerWindow.Focus(); } catch {}
                }
                IsProcessing = false;
            }
        }
        private void ScanFamilyRecursively(
            Document parentDoc, 
            Family family, 
            List<ObjectModel> exportedStyles, 
            HashSet<string> uniqueKeys, 
            int depth, 
            string parentName,
            bool hasClassSelection,
            List<Type> selectedSystemClasses,
            List<ElementId> checkedCategoryIds)
        {
            if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
            if (family == null || !family.IsEditable) return;
            Document? familyDoc = null;
            try
            {
                familyDoc = parentDoc.EditFamily(family);
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return;
            }
            if (familyDoc == null) return;
            try
            {
                IEnumerable<Element> familyElements;
                if (hasClassSelection)
                {
                    familyElements = CollectSelectedElements(familyDoc, selectedSystemClasses, checkedCategoryIds);
                }
                else
                {
                    familyElements = CollectAnnotationStyles(familyDoc);
                }
                foreach (var elem in familyElements)
                {
                    if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
                    try
                    {
                        var serialModel = ModelsToSerialize.ByElement(elem, true);
                        if (serialModel != null)
                        {
                            string key = "";
                            if (serialModel is CategoryModel catModel)
                            {
                                key = $"Category:[{catModel.ParentCategoryName ?? ""}]_{catModel.Name}";
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                key = $"{serialModel.Class}:{serialModel.Name}";
                            }
                            if (!uniqueKeys.Contains(key))
                            {
                                uniqueKeys.Add(key);
                                exportedStyles.Add(serialModel);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception)
                    {
                    }
                }
                if (ProcessNested)
                {
                    IList<Family> nestedFamilies = new FilteredElementCollector(familyDoc)
                        .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                        .Cast<Family>()
                        .ToList();
                    var nestedFamiliesInfo = nestedFamilies
                        .Select(nf => new { Id = nf.Id, Name = nf.Name, IsEditable = nf.IsEditable })
                        .ToList();
                    foreach (var nfInfo in nestedFamiliesInfo)
                    {
                        if (ProgressCoordinator.IsCancelled()) return;
                        if (nfInfo.IsEditable)
                        {
                            Family? freshNestedFamily = new FilteredElementCollector(familyDoc)
                                .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                                .Cast<Family>()
                                .FirstOrDefault(nf => nf.Name == nfInfo.Name);
                            if (freshNestedFamily != null && freshNestedFamily.IsValidObject)
                            {
                                ScanFamilyRecursively(familyDoc, freshNestedFamily, exportedStyles, uniqueKeys, depth + 1, family.Name, hasClassSelection, selectedSystemClasses, checkedCategoryIds);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                try
                {
                    familyDoc.Close(false);
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                }
            }
        }
        private List<Element> CollectSelectedElements(Document doc, List<Type> selectedSystemClasses, List<ElementId> checkedCategoryIds)
        {
            var elements = new List<Element>();
            var seenIds = new HashSet<ElementId>();
            if (selectedSystemClasses.Any())
            {
                foreach (var cls in selectedSystemClasses)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var classElements = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                            .OfClass(cls)
                            .ToElements();
                        if (cls == typeof(TextElementType))
                        {
                            foreach (var elem in classElements)
                            {
                                if (!(elem is TextNoteType) && !seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                                {
                                    seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                    elements.Add(elem);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            foreach (var elem in classElements)
                            {
                                if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                                {
                                    seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                                    elements.Add(elem);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch {}
                }
            }
            if (checkedCategoryIds.Any())
            {
                var catFilters = checkedCategoryIds.Select(id => new ElementCategoryFilter(id)).Cast<ElementFilter>().ToList();
                ElementFilter categoryFilter = catFilters.Count == 1 ? catFilters.First() : new LogicalOrFilter(catFilters);
                try
                {
                    var familySymbols = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                         .OfClass(typeof(FamilySymbol))
                         .WherePasses(categoryFilter)
                         .ToElements();
                    foreach (var elem in familySymbols)
                    {
                        if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                        {
                            seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                            elements.Add(elem);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch {}
            }
            if (ClassSelection.ExportLabelTypes)
            {
                try
                {
                    var labelSymbols = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                        .OfClass(typeof(FamilySymbol))
                        .Cast<FamilySymbol>()
                        .Where(fs => fs.Category != null && fs.Category.CategoryType == CategoryType.Annotation)
                        .Cast<Element>()
                        .ToList();
                    foreach (var elem in labelSymbols)
                    {
                        if (!seenIds.Contains(elem.Id))
                        {
                            seenIds.Add(elem.Id);
                            elements.Add(elem);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch {}
            }
            return elements;
        }
        private List<ElementType> CollectAnnotationStyles(Document doc)
        {
            List<ElementType> styles = new List<ElementType>();
            var textTypes = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(TextNoteType))
                .Cast<ElementType>();
            styles.AddRange(textTypes);
            var textElementTypes = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(TextElementType))
                .Cast<ElementType>();
            foreach (var t in textElementTypes)
            {
                if (!styles.Any(s => s.Id == t.Id))
                    styles.Add(t);
            }
            var dimTypes = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(DimensionType))
                .Cast<ElementType>();
            styles.AddRange(dimTypes);
            var filledRegionTypes = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(FilledRegionType))
                .Cast<ElementType>();
            styles.AddRange(filledRegionTypes);
            var arrowheads = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(ElementType))
                .Cast<ElementType>()
                .Where(e => e.FamilyName == "Arrowhead");
            styles.AddRange(arrowheads);
            try
            {
                var labelSymbols = new FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                    .OfClass(typeof(FamilySymbol))
                    .Cast<FamilySymbol>()
                    .Where(fs => fs.Category != null && fs.Category.CategoryType == CategoryType.Annotation)
                    .Cast<ElementType>();
                styles.AddRange(labelSymbols);
            }
            catch {}
            return styles;
        }
        private void ExecuteCancel(object obj)
        {
            CloseAction?.Invoke();
        }
        private void AllowUIToUpdate()
        {
            var dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher ?? System.Windows.Threading.Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher;
            dispatcher.Invoke(System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Background, new Action(delegate { }));
        }
        #region Selective Export Workflows
        private void AddAnnotations()
        {
            var annotationTypes = CollectAnnotationStyles(_doc);
            var list = annotationTypes.Select(e => Tuple.Create(e.Name, e.Id)).ToList();
            ShowChecklistAndAdd("Select Annotation Types", "Select annotation types to add to the export cart:", list);
        }
        private void AddViews()
        {
            var viewsList = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.View))
                .Cast<Autodesk.Revit.DB.View>()
                .Where(v => !v.IsTemplate)
                .ToList();
            var templatesList = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.View))
                .Cast<Autodesk.Revit.DB.View>()
                .Where(v => v.IsTemplate)
                .ToList();
            var list = templatesList.Select(v => Tuple.Create("[Template] " + v.Name, v.Id))
                .Concat(viewsList.Select(v => Tuple.Create("[View] " + v.Name, v.Id)))
                .ToList();
            ShowChecklistAndAdd("Select Views & Templates", "Select view templates and views to add to the export cart:", list);
        }
        private void AddModelSystemTypes()
        {
            var classes = new[]
            {
                typeof(WallType),
                typeof(FloorType),
                typeof(RoofType),
                typeof(CeilingType),
                typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture.RailingType),
                typeof(Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture.StairsType)
            };
            var list = new List<Tuple<string, ElementId>>();
            foreach (var cls in classes)
            {
                try
                {
                    var types = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                        .OfClass(cls)
                        .Cast<ElementType>()
                        .Select(e => Tuple.Create($"[{cls.Name.Replace("Type", "")}] " + e.Name, e.Id));
                    list.AddRange(types);
                }
                catch {}
            }
            ShowChecklistAndAdd("Select Model System Types", "Select model system types to add to the export cart:", list);
        }
        private void AddFamilyTypes()
        {
            var families = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(Family))
                .Cast<Family>()
                .ToList();
            var list = new List<Tuple<string, ElementId>>();
            foreach (var f in families)
            {
                try
                {
                    var symbols = f.GetFamilySymbolIds().Select(id => _doc.GetElement(id)).Cast<FamilySymbol>();
                    foreach (var sym in symbols)
                    {
                        list.Add(Tuple.Create($"{f.Name} : {sym.Name}", sym.Id));
                    }
                }
                catch {}
            }
            ShowChecklistAndAdd("Select Family Types", "Select loaded family types to add to the export cart:", list);
        }
        private void AddMaterials()
        {
            var materials = new FilteredElementCollector(_doc)
                .OfClass(typeof(Material))
                .Cast<Material>()
                .Select(m => Tuple.Create(m.Name, m.Id))
                .ToList();
            ShowChecklistAndAdd("Select Materials", "Select materials to add to the export cart:", materials);
        }
        private void AddCategories()
        {
            var list = new List<Tuple<string, ElementId>>();
            foreach (Category cat in _doc.Settings.Categories)
            {
                if (cat.IsVisibleInUI)
                {
                    list.Add(Tuple.Create(cat.Name, cat.Id));
                }
            }
            ShowChecklistAndAdd("Select Categories", "Select categories to add to the export cart:", list);
        }
        private void AddElements()
        {
            HideViewRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
            try
            {
                var uidoc = _uiapp.ActiveUIDocument;
                var picked = uidoc.Selection.PickObjects(
                    Autodesk.Revit.UI.Selection.ObjectType.Element,
                    "Select physical elements on the canvas to add to the export cart."
                );
                if (picked != null)
                {
                    foreach (var reference in picked)
                    {
                        var id = reference.ElementId;
                        if (!SelectedExportItems.Contains(id))
                        {
                            SelectedExportItems.Add(id);
                        }
                    }
                    SyncCartItemsDisplay();
                }
            }
            catch (Autodesk.Revit.Exceptions.OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show($"Selection error: {ex.Message}", "Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                ShowViewRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
            }
        }
        private void RemoveCartItem(object wrapperParameter)
        {
            var wrapper = wrapperParameter as ElementTypeWrapperVM;
            if (wrapper != null)
            {
                var targetId = SelectedExportItems.FirstOrDefault(id => 
                {
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                    return id.IntegerValue == (int)wrapper.GetUpdatedModel().Id;
#else
                    return id.Value == wrapper.GetUpdatedModel().Id;
#endif
                });
                if (targetId != null)
                {
                    SelectedExportItems.Remove(targetId);
                    SyncCartItemsDisplay();
                }
            }
        }
        private void SyncCartItemsDisplay()
        {
            CartItems.Clear();
            foreach (var id in SelectedExportItems)
            {
                try
                {
                    ElementModel? model = null;
                    string group = "ElementTypes";
                    Element? elem = _doc.GetElement(id);
                    if (elem != null)
                    {
                        model = ModelsToSerialize.ByElement(elem, true);
                        if (model == null)
                        {
                            model = new ElementModel()
                            {
                                Name = elem.Name,
                                Class = elem.GetType().FullName ?? string.Empty,
                                Category = elem.Category?.Name ?? "Other",
                                Element = elem
                            };
#if REVIT2022 || REVIT2023
                            model.Id = elem.Id.IntegerValue;
#else
                            model.Id = elem.Id.Value;
#endif
                        }
                        if (model is FilledRegionTypeModel) group = "FillRegionTypes";
                        else if (model is DimensionTypeModel) group = "DimensionTypes";
                        else if (model is HostObjTypeModel) group = "HostObjTypes";
                        else if (model is MaterialModel) group = "Materials";
                        else if (model is ViewModel) group = "Views";
                        else if (elem is Family) group = "FamilyTypes";
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Category? cat = Category.GetCategory(_doc, id);
                        if (cat != null)
                        {
                            model = ModelsToSerialize.ByCategory(cat, _doc, true);
                            group = "Categories";
                        }
                    }
                    if (model != null)
                    {
                        var wrapper = new ElementTypeWrapperVM((ElementModel)model) { Group = group };
                        CartItems.Add(wrapper);
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                }
            }
        }
        private void ShowChecklistAndAdd(string title, string instruction, IEnumerable<Tuple<string, ElementId>> items)
        {
            var vm = new ListByCheckboxViewModel
            {
                Title = title,
                Instruction = instruction
            };
            vm.SetItems(items);
            var view = new Synthetic.Shared.UI.ListByCheckboxView(_uiapp.MainWindowHandle)
            {
                DataContext = vm
            };
            vm.CloseAction = (dialogResult) =>
            {
                view.DialogResult = dialogResult;
                view.Close();
            };
            if (view.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                var checkedIds = vm.CheckedElementIds;
                foreach (var id in checkedIds)
                {
                    if (!SelectedExportItems.Contains(id))
                    {
                        SelectedExportItems.Add(id);
                    }
                }
                SyncCartItemsDisplay();
            }
        }
        #endregion
        private void HarvestDependencies(List<Element> elementsToProcess, Document doc)
        {
            var processedIds = new HashSet<ElementId>(elementsToProcess.Select(e => e.Id));
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsToProcess.Count; i++)
            {
                Element elem = elementsToProcess[i];
                if (elem == null || !elem.IsValidObject) continue;
                if (elem is HostObjAttributes hostObjType)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        CompoundStructure cs = hostObjType.GetCompoundStructure();
                        if (cs != null)
                        {
                            foreach (CompoundStructureLayer layer in cs.GetLayers())
                            {
                                ElementId matId = layer.MaterialId;
                                if (matId != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(matId))
                                {
                                    Element matElem = doc.GetElement(matId);
                                    if (matElem is Material)
                                    {
                                        elementsToProcess.Add(matElem);
                                        processedIds.Add(matId);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch {}
                }
                if (elem is Material mat)
                {
                    var patternIds = new List<ElementId>();
                    try { patternIds.Add(mat.CutForegroundPatternId); } catch {}
                    try { patternIds.Add(mat.CutBackgroundPatternId); } catch {}
                    try { patternIds.Add(mat.SurfaceForegroundPatternId); } catch {}
                    try { patternIds.Add(mat.SurfaceBackgroundPatternId); } catch {}
                    foreach (ElementId fpId in patternIds)
                    {
                        if (fpId != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(fpId))
                        {
                            Element fpElem = doc.GetElement(fpId);
                            if (fpElem is FillPatternElement)
                            {
                                elementsToProcess.Add(fpElem);
                                processedIds.Add(fpId);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    try
                    {
                        ElementId assetId = mat.AppearanceAssetId;
                        if (assetId != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(assetId))
                        {
                            Element assetElem = doc.GetElement(assetId);
                            if (assetElem is PropertySetElement)
                            {
                                elementsToProcess.Add(assetElem);
                                processedIds.Add(assetId);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch {}
                }
                if (elem is FilledRegionType frt)
                {
                    var fpIds = new List<ElementId>();
                    try { fpIds.Add(frt.ForegroundPatternId); } catch {}
                    try { fpIds.Add(frt.BackgroundPatternId); } catch {}
                    foreach (ElementId fpId in fpIds)
                    {
                        if (fpId != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(fpId))
                        {
                            Element fpElem = doc.GetElement(fpId);
                            if (fpElem is FillPatternElement)
                            {
                                elementsToProcess.Add(fpElem);
                                processedIds.Add(fpId);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (elem is TextNoteType || elem is DimensionType)
                {
                    var arrowParamIds = new List<BuiltInParameter>
                    {
                        BuiltInParameter.LEADER_ARROWHEAD,
                        BuiltInParameter.DIM_STYLE_LEADER_TICK_MARK,
                        BuiltInParameter.WITNS_LINE_TICK_MARK,
                        BuiltInParameter.DIM_STYLE_CENTERLINE_TICK_MARK,
                        BuiltInParameter.DIM_LEADER_ARROWHEAD
                    };
                    foreach (var bip in arrowParamIds)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            Parameter p = elem.get_Parameter(bip);
                            if (p != null && p.StorageType == StorageType.ElementId)
                            {
                                ElementId fsId = p.AsElementId();
                                if (fsId != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(fsId))
                                {
                                    Element fsElem = doc.GetElement(fsId);
                                    if (fsElem != null)
                                    {
                                        elementsToProcess.Add(fsElem);
                                        processedIds.Add(fsId);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        catch {}
                    }
                }
                if (elem is Autodesk.Revit.DB.View view)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var filterIds = view.GetFilters();
                        foreach (ElementId filterId in filterIds)
                        {
                            if (!processedIds.Contains(filterId))
                            {
                                Element filterElem = doc.GetElement(filterId);
                                if (filterElem is FilterElement)
                                {
                                    elementsToProcess.Add(filterElem);
                                    processedIds.Add(filterId);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    catch {}
                    try
                    {
                        foreach (Category cat in doc.Settings.Categories)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                OverrideGraphicSettings ogs = view.GetCategoryOverrides(cat.Id);
                                if (ogs != null)
                                {
                                    var ogsIds = new List<ElementId>
                                    {
                                        ogs.ProjectionLinePatternId,
                                        ogs.CutLinePatternId,
                                        ogs.SurfaceForegroundPatternId,
                                        ogs.SurfaceBackgroundPatternId,
                                        ogs.CutForegroundPatternId,
                                        ogs.CutBackgroundPatternId
                                    };
                                    foreach (var id in ogsIds)
                                    {
                                        if (id != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(id))
                                        {
                                            Element dep = doc.GetElement(id);
                                            if (dep != null)
                                            {
                                                elementsToProcess.Add(dep);
                                                processedIds.Add(id);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            catch {}
                        }
                    }
                    catch {}
                }
                try
                {
                    foreach (Parameter p in elem.Parameters)
                    {
                        if (p.StorageType == StorageType.ElementId)
                        {
                            ElementId depId = p.AsElementId();
                            if (depId != ElementId.InvalidElementId && !processedIds.Contains(depId))
                            {
                                Element depElem = doc.GetElement(depId);
                                if (depElem != null)
                                {
                                    if (depElem is LinePatternElement || depElem is FillPatternElement || depElem is Material || depElem is PropertySetElement)
                                    {
                                        elementsToProcess.Add(depElem);
                                        processedIds.Add(depId);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch {}
            }
        }
    }

using System;

{
    public enum SearchScope
    {
        ElementNames,
        ParameterValues
    }
    public class FindReplaceViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        private readonly JsonEditorMainViewModel _mainVM;

        private string _replaceText = string.Empty;
        private SearchScope _scope = SearchScope.ElementNames;
        public SearchScope Scope
        {

            {

            {

                {

        private int _currentElementIndex = -1;
        private int _currentFieldIndex = -1; // 0 = Element Name, >= 1 = Parameter index
        private int _currentMatchCharIndex = -1;

        {

            {
                if (SetProperty(ref _findText, value))
                {
                    ResetSearch();
                }
            }

        public ICommand FindNextCommand { get; }
        public ICommand FindPreviousCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ReplaceCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ReplaceAllCommand { get; }
        public ICommand CloseCommand { get; }
        public FindReplaceViewModel(JsonEditorMainViewModel mainVM)
        {
            _mainVM = mainVM ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mainVM));
            FindNextCommand = new RelayCommand(o => FindNext());
            FindPreviousCommand = new RelayCommand(o => FindPrevious());
            ReplaceCommand = new RelayCommand(o => Replace());
            ReplaceAllCommand = new RelayCommand(o => ReplaceAll());
            CloseCommand = new RelayCommand(o => CloseWindow(o as Window));
        }
        private void ResetSearch()
        {
            _currentElementIndex = -1;
            _currentFieldIndex = -1;
            _currentMatchCharIndex = -1;
        }
        private class SearchableField
        {
            public int ElementIndex { get; set; }
            public int FieldIndex { get; set; }
            public ElementTypeWrapperVM? Element { get; set; }
            public string Value { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        }
        private System.Collections.Generic.List<SearchableField> GetSearchableFields()
        {
            var list = new System.Collections.Generic.List<SearchableField>();
            for (int i = 0; i < _mainVM.WrappedElements.Count; i++)
            {
                var el = _mainVM.WrappedElements[i];
                if (Scope == SearchScope.ElementNames)
                {
                    list.Add(new SearchableField
                    {
                        ElementIndex = i,
                        FieldIndex = 0,
                        Element = el,
                        Value = el.Name ?? string.Empty
                    });
                }
                else
                {
                    for (int p = 0; p < el.Parameters.Count; p++)
                    {
                        var param = el.Parameters[p];
                        if (!param.IsReadOnly)
                        {
                            list.Add(new SearchableField
                            {
                                ElementIndex = i,
                                FieldIndex = p + 1,
                                Element = el,
                                Value = param.Value ?? string.Empty
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return list;
        }
        public bool FindNext()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FindText))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please enter search text.", "Find", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }
            var fields = GetSearchableFields();
            if (fields.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No elements loaded to search.", "Find", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }
            int startIndex = fields.FindIndex(f => f.ElementIndex == _currentElementIndex && f.FieldIndex == _currentFieldIndex);
            int startChar = _currentMatchCharIndex + 1;
            if (startIndex == -1)
            {
                startIndex = 0;
                startChar = 0;
            }
            int fieldIdx = startIndex;
            int fieldsSearched = 0;
            while (fieldsSearched <= fields.Count)
            {
                var field = fields[fieldIdx];
                string val = field.Value;
                int searchStart = 0;
                if (fieldsSearched == 0)
                {
                    searchStart = startChar;
                }
                if (searchStart < val.Length)
                {
                    int matchIdx = val.IndexOf(FindText, searchStart, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    if (matchIdx >= 0)
                    {
                        if (fieldsSearched > 0 && fieldIdx == startIndex && matchIdx >= startChar)
                        {
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            _currentElementIndex = field.ElementIndex;
                            _currentFieldIndex = field.FieldIndex;
                            _currentMatchCharIndex = matchIdx;
                            HighlightMatch(field.Element);
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                fieldIdx++;
                fieldsSearched++;
                if (fieldIdx >= fields.Count)
                {
                    fieldIdx = 0;
                }
            }
            MessageBox.Show("Finished searching the document. No matches found.", "Find", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            ResetSearch();
            return false;
        }
        public bool FindPrevious()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FindText))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please enter search text.", "Find", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }
            var fields = GetSearchableFields();
            if (fields.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No elements loaded to search.", "Find", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }
            int startIndex = fields.FindIndex(f => f.ElementIndex == _currentElementIndex && f.FieldIndex == _currentFieldIndex);
            int startChar = _currentMatchCharIndex - 1;
            if (startIndex == -1)
            {
                startIndex = fields.Count - 1;
                startChar = -1; // End of string
            }
            int fieldIdx = startIndex;
            int fieldsSearched = 0;
            while (fieldsSearched <= fields.Count)
            {
                var field = fields[fieldIdx];
                string val = field.Value;
                int searchLen;
                if (fieldsSearched == 0)
                {
                    searchLen = _currentMatchCharIndex == -1 ? val.Length : _currentMatchCharIndex;
                }
                else
                {
                    searchLen = val.Length;
                }
                if (searchLen > 0)
                {
                    int matchIdx = val.LastIndexOf(FindText, searchLen - 1, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    if (matchIdx >= 0)
                    {
                        if (fieldsSearched > 0 && fieldIdx == startIndex && matchIdx <= startChar)
                        {
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            _currentElementIndex = field.ElementIndex;
                            _currentFieldIndex = field.FieldIndex;
                            _currentMatchCharIndex = matchIdx;
                            HighlightMatch(field.Element);
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                fieldIdx--;
                fieldsSearched++;
                if (fieldIdx < 0)
                {
                    fieldIdx = fields.Count - 1;
                }
            }
            MessageBox.Show("Finished searching the document. No matches found.", "Find", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            ResetSearch();
            return false;
        }
        public void Replace()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FindText))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please enter search text.", "Replace", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }
            if (_currentElementIndex >= 0 && _currentElementIndex < _mainVM.WrappedElements.Count)
            {
                var element = _mainVM.WrappedElements[_currentElementIndex];
                string? val = GetFieldValue(element, _currentFieldIndex, out bool isEditable);
                if (isEditable && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(val) && _currentMatchCharIndex >= 0 && _currentMatchCharIndex < val!.Length)
                {
                    if (_currentMatchCharIndex + FindText.Length <= val.Length)
                    {
                        string matchSubstring = val.Substring(_currentMatchCharIndex, FindText.Length);
                        if (string.Equals(matchSubstring, FindText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            string newVal = val.Remove(_currentMatchCharIndex, FindText.Length)
                                              .Insert(_currentMatchCharIndex, ReplaceText ?? string.Empty);
                            SetFieldValue(element, _currentFieldIndex, newVal);
                            _currentMatchCharIndex = _currentMatchCharIndex + (ReplaceText ?? string.Empty).Length - 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            FindNext();
        }
        public void ReplaceAll()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FindText))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please enter search text.", "Replace All", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }
            int totalReplaced = 0;
            string findText = FindText;
            string replaceText = ReplaceText ?? string.Empty;
            foreach (var element in _mainVM.WrappedElements)
            {
                if (Scope == SearchScope.ElementNames)
                {
                    string name = element.Name;
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
                    {
                        string newName = ReplaceCaseInsensitive(name, findText, replaceText, out bool replacedName);
                        if (replacedName)
                        {
                            element.Name = newName;
                            totalReplaced++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    foreach (var param in element.Parameters)
                    {
                        if (!param.IsReadOnly)
                        {
                            string val = param.Value;
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(val))
                            {
                                string newVal = ReplaceCaseInsensitive(val, findText, replaceText, out bool replacedParam);
                                if (replacedParam)
                                {
                                    param.Value = newVal;
                                    totalReplaced++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            _mainVM.UpdateSelectedElements();
            ResetSearch();
            MessageBox.Show($"Completed Replace All. Replaced {totalReplaced} occurrences.", "Replace All", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
        }
        private string ReplaceCaseInsensitive(string input, string search, string replace, out bool replaced)
        {
            replaced = false;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(search)) return input;
            System.Text.StringBuilder sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            int lastPos = 0;
            int pos = input.IndexOf(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            while (pos >= 0)
            {
                sb.Append(input.Substring(lastPos, pos - lastPos));
                sb.Append(replace);
                lastPos = pos + search.Length;
                pos = input.IndexOf(search, lastPos, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                replaced = true;
            }
            sb.Append(input.Substring(lastPos));
            return sb.ToString();
        }
        private string? GetFieldValue(ElementTypeWrapperVM el, int fieldIndex, out bool isEditable)
        {
            isEditable = false;
            if (fieldIndex == 0)
            {
                isEditable = true;
                return el.Name;
            }
            int paramIndex = fieldIndex - 1;
            if (paramIndex >= 0 && paramIndex < el.Parameters.Count)
            {
                var param = el.Parameters[paramIndex];
                isEditable = !param.IsReadOnly;
                return param.Value;
            }
            return null;
        }
        private void SetFieldValue(ElementTypeWrapperVM el, int fieldIndex, string value)
        {
            if (fieldIndex == 0)
            {
                el.Name = value;
            }
            else
            {
                int paramIndex = fieldIndex - 1;
                if (paramIndex >= 0 && paramIndex < el.Parameters.Count)
                {
                    var param = el.Parameters[paramIndex];
                    if (!param.IsReadOnly)
                    {
                        param.Value = value;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        private void HighlightMatch(ElementTypeWrapperVM? element)
        {
            if (element == null) return;
            foreach (var el in _mainVM.WrappedElements)
            {
                el.IsSelected = (el == element);
            }
            _mainVM.UpdateSelectedElements();
        }
        private void CloseWindow(Window? window)
        {
            window?.Close();
        }
    }
}

        public void SaveJson(string filePath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("File path cannot be null or empty.", nameof(filePath));
            }
            List<ObjectModel> allModels = WrappedElements
                .Select(w => {
                    var model = w.GetUpdatedModel();
                    if (model is CategoryModel cat)
                    {
                        cat.SyncFromParameters();
                    }
                    return (ObjectModel)model;
                })
                .ToList();
            allModels.AddRange(_preservedNonElementTypeModels);
            string serializedJson = ModelsToSerialize.SerializeToJson(allModels);
            File.WriteAllText(filePath, serializedJson);
            CurrentFilePath = filePath;
        }
        public void ApplyFilter()

        public void UpdateSelectedElements()
        {
            SelectedElements.Clear();
            foreach (var element in WrappedElements)
            {
                if (element.IsSelected)
                {
                    SelectedElements.Add(element);
                }
            }
            SelectedElement = SelectedElements.FirstOrDefault();
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedElements));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedName));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedDisplayClass));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedDisplayCategory));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedAliasesString));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsSingleElementSelected));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsEditorVisible));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsNameEditingAllowed));
            CalculateParameterIntersection();
        }

        {
            foreach (var element in WrappedElements)
            {
                element.IsSelected = SelectedElements.Contains(element);
            }
            SelectedElement = SelectedElements.FirstOrDefault();

            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedName));

            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedDisplayCategory));
