```xml
<Window x:Class="Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views.EnforceStandardsView"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:views="clr-namespace:Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views"
        Title="Enforce Project Standards" Height="650" Width="750" MinHeight="600" MinWidth="700" 
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner" Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#F1F1F1">
    <Grid Margin="15">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- File Path -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Main Checkboxes -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Class Selection TabControl -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Family Options GroupBox -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Action Buttons -->
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- File Selection Section -->
        <GroupBox Grid.Row="0" Header="JSON Style Standards File" Margin="0,0,0,10" Padding="8"
                  Foreground="#F1F1F1" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" Background="#2D2D30"
                  Visibility="{Binding FileSelectionVisibility}">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <TextBox Grid.Column="0" Text="{Binding FilePath, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" 
                          Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="White" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1"
                          VerticalContentAlignment="Center" Padding="6,4" Margin="0,0,8,0" Height="28"/>
                <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="Browse..." Command="{Binding BrowseCommand}" 
                          Width="85" Height="28" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"/>
            </Grid>
        </GroupBox>

        <!-- Main Options -->
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Margin="5,0,0,10">
            <CheckBox Content="Merge and Rename Alias Types into standard types" 
                      IsChecked="{Binding MergeAliases}" Foreground="#FFF" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
            <CheckBox Content="Update loaded families in the project" 
                      IsChecked="{Binding UpdateFamilies}" Foreground="#FFF" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
        </StackPanel>

        <!-- Class Selection TabControl -->
        <views:StandardsClassSelectionControl Grid.Row="2" DataContext="{Binding ClassSelection}" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

        <!-- Family Settings GroupBox (Enabled when UpdateFamilies is checked) -->
        <GroupBox Grid.Row="3" Header="Family Processing Settings" Padding="10" Margin="0,0,0,15" 
                  Foreground="#F1F1F1" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" Background="#2D2D30"
                  IsEnabled="{Binding UpdateFamilies}">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <CheckBox Grid.Row="0" Content="Process nested families recursively" 
                          IsChecked="{Binding ProcessNested}" Foreground="#FFF" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                <CheckBox Grid.Row="1" Content="Purge unused style types in families" 
                          IsChecked="{Binding PurgeUnused}" Foreground="#FFF" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

                <TextBlock Grid.Row="2" Text="Family Categories Filter:" Foreground="#808080" Margin="0,5,0,5"/>
                <ComboBox Grid.Row="3" ItemsSource="{Binding CategoryFilters}" 
                          SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedCategoryFilter}" 
                          Height="28" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
            </Grid>
        </GroupBox>

        <!-- Cancel / Enforce / Analyze Actions -->
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="4" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
            <Button Content="Enforce Standards" Command="{Binding EnforceCommand}" Width="150" Height="30" Padding="5" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                    Background="#007ACC" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
            <Button Content="Analyze" Command="{Binding AnalyzeCommand}" Width="100" Height="30" Padding="5" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                    Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" Foreground="White" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
            <Button Content="Cancel" Command="{Binding CancelCommand}" Width="80" Height="30" Padding="5"
                    Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

```xml
    <Grid Margin="15">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Input fields -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Action buttons -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Close button -->
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Inputs Grid -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,15">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="90"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- Find What row -->
            <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Text="Find what:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,10" Foreground="#CCCCCC"/>
            <TextBox Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" 
                     Text="{Binding FindText, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" 
                     Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#F1F1F1" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" 
                     Padding="6,4" Height="26" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

            <!-- Replace With row -->
            <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" Text="Replace with:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,10" Foreground="#CCCCCC"/>
            <TextBox Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" 
                     Text="{Binding ReplaceText, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" 
                     Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#F1F1F1" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" 
                     Padding="6,4" Height="26" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

            <!-- Scope Selection row -->
            <TextBlock Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="0" Text="Scope:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#CCCCCC"/>
            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <RadioButton Content="Element Names" IsChecked="{Binding IsElementNamesScope}" Foreground="#F1F1F1" Margin="0,0,20,0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                <RadioButton Content="Parameter Values" IsChecked="{Binding IsParameterValuesScope}" Foreground="#F1F1F1" Cursor="Hand"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Action Buttons -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,0,0,15">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Search navigation buttons (Left aligned) -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal">
                <Button Content="◀ Find Prev" Command="{Binding FindPreviousCommand}" Width="90" Height="26" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                <Button Content="Find Next ▶" Command="{Binding FindNextCommand}" Width="90" Height="26" Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" Cursor="Hand"/>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Action buttons (Right aligned) -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                <Button Content="Replace" Command="{Binding ReplaceCommand}" Width="80" Height="26" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" Cursor="Hand"/>
                <Button Content="Replace All" Command="{Binding ReplaceAllCommand}" Width="90" Height="26" Background="#007ACC" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" Cursor="Hand"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Close Button Row -->
        <Button Grid.Row="2" Content="Close" Command="{Binding CloseCommand}" CommandParameter="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" Width="80" Height="26" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" Cursor="Hand"/>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

```xml
<Window x:Class="Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views.ImportSummaryWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Import Styles Summary" Height="500" Width="700" MinHeight="400" MinWidth="550"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner" Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#F1F1F1">
    
    <Grid Margin="15">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Title -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- High-Level Stats Cards -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- DataGrid -->
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Action Buttons -->
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Title -->
        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Text="Import Process Results" FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,15" Foreground="White"/>

        <!-- High-level stats panel -->
        <UniformGrid Grid.Row="1" Columns="4" Margin="0,0,0,15">
            <!-- Created Card -->
            <Border Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Margin="0,0,8,0" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel HorizontalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding CreatedCount}" FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#4EC9B0" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Elements Created" FontSize="11" Foreground="#CCCCCC" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <!-- Updated Card -->
            <Border Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Margin="0,0,8,0" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel HorizontalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding UpdatedCount}" FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#569CD6" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Elements Updated" FontSize="11" Foreground="#CCCCCC" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <!-- Renamed Card -->
            <Border Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Margin="0,0,8,0" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel HorizontalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding RenamedCount}" FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#DCDCAA" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Aliases Renamed" FontSize="11" Foreground="#CCCCCC" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>

            <!-- Failed Card -->
            <Border Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel HorizontalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding ErrorsCount}" FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#F44747" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Errors / Failed" FontSize="11" Foreground="#CCCCCC" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>
        </UniformGrid>

        <!-- Detailed Log Grid -->
        <DataGrid Grid.Row="2" ItemsSource="{Binding LogItems}" AutoGenerateColumns="False" 
                  CanUserAddRows="False" CanUserDeleteRows="False" IsReadOnly="True"
                  HeadersVisibility="Column" GridLinesVisibility="Horizontal"
                  BorderThickness="1" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" Background="#2D2D30"
                  RowBackground="#2D2D30" AlternatingRowBackground="#252526" Foreground="#F1F1F1"
                  RowHeaderWidth="0" HorizontalGridLinesBrush="#3F3F46" VerticalGridLinesBrush="Transparent"
                  Margin="0,0,0,15">

            <DataGrid.Resources>
                <Style TargetType="DataGridColumnHeader">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1E1E1E" />
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#CCCCCC" />
                    <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,0,0,1" />
                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46" />
                    <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,6" />
                    <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" />
                </Style>
                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                    <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" />
                </Style>
            </DataGrid.Resources>

            <DataGrid.Columns>
                <!-- Action Column -->
                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Action" Width="100">
                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Action}" FontWeight="Bold" Padding="8,4" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock.Style>
                                    <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                        <Style.Triggers>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Action}" Value="Created">
                                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#4EC9B0"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Action}" Value="Updated">
                                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#569CD6"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Action}" Value="Renamed">
                                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#DCDCAA"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Action}" Value="Failed">
                                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#F44747"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Action}" Value="Canceled">
                                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#808080"/>
                                            </DataTrigger>
                                        </Style.Triggers>
                                    </Style>
                                </TextBlock.Style>
                            </TextBlock>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                <!-- Class Column -->
                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Class" Binding="{Binding Class}" Width="150">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,4"/>
                            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#E0E0E0"/>
                        </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                </DataGridTextColumn>

                <!-- ElementName Column -->
                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Element Name" Binding="{Binding ElementName}" Width="180">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,4"/>
                            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF"/>
                        </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                </DataGridTextColumn>

                <!-- Message Column -->
                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Details / Message" Binding="{Binding Message}" Width="*">
                    <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,4"/>
                            <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#CCCCCC"/>
                            <Setter Property="TextTrimming" Value="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        </Style>
                    </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                </DataGridTextColumn>
            </DataGrid.Columns>
        </DataGrid>

        <!-- Close Button -->
        <Button Grid.Row="3" Content="Close" Click="CloseButton_Click" Width="90" Height="28" 
                HorizontalAlignment="Right" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="White" BorderThickness="0"/>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

```xml
<Window x:Class="Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views.JsonEditorWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:vm="clr-namespace:Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels"
        Title="Synthetic Standards JSON Editor" 
        Height="650" Width="850" MinHeight="500" MinWidth="750" 
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner"
        Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#F1F1F1">
    
    <Window.Resources>
        <Style TargetType="ComboBoxItem">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1E1E1E"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#F1F1F1"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#007ACC"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#007ACC"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Margin="15">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Action bar -->
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Split pane content -->
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Action Bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0" Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Padding="10" Margin="0,0,0,12">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="📁 Load JSON..." Command="{Binding LoadCommand}" Width="120" Height="28" Padding="5,2" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0"/>
                <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="💾 Save" Command="{Binding SaveCommand}" Width="80" Height="28" Padding="5,2" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0"/>
                <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="Save As..." Command="{Binding SaveAsCommand}" Width="80" Height="28" Padding="5,2" Margin="0,0,15,0" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0"/>
                <Button Grid.Column="3" Content="📥 Import Selected" Command="{Binding ImportSelectedCommand}" Width="130" Height="28" Padding="5,2" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="#007ACC" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                <Button Grid.Column="4" Content="⚙️ Generate" Command="{Binding GenerateCommand}" Width="100" Height="28" Padding="5,2" Margin="0,0,15,0" Background="#007ACC" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="5" Text="{Binding CurrentFilePath, TargetNullValue='No file loaded'}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#808080" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- Main Body split panel -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="280" MinWidth="200"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="5"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" MinWidth="350"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Left Navigation Pane -->
            <Grid Grid.Column="0">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Search bar -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Action bar/Toolbar -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Selection Toolbar -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- List Box -->
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <!-- Search Input with placeholder -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                    <TextBox x:Name="SearchBox" 
                             Text="{Binding SearchText, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" 
                             Padding="6,4" 
                             Background="#2D2D30" 
                             Foreground="#F1F1F1" 
                             BorderBrush="#3F3F46" 
                             BorderThickness="1"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             Height="28"/>
                    <TextBlock IsHitTestVisible="False" 
                               Text="Search standards..." 
                               VerticalAlignment="Center" 
                               HorizontalAlignment="Left" 
                               Margin="8,0,0,0" 
                               Foreground="#808080" 
                               FontStyle="Italic">
                        <TextBlock.Style>
                            <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                <Style.Triggers>
                                    <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Text, ElementName=SearchBox}" Value="">
                                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    </DataTrigger>
                                </Style.Triggers>
                            </Style>
                        </TextBlock.Style>
                    </TextBlock>
                </Grid> <!-- Search bar container -->

                <!-- Action Bar/Toolbar -->
                <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                    <Button Content="➕ Duplicate" Command="{Binding DuplicateCommand}" ToolTip="Duplicate selected elements" Width="80" Height="24" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                    <Button Content="❌ Delete" Command="{Binding DeleteCommand}" ToolTip="Delete selected elements" Width="60" Height="24" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                    <Button Content="🔗 Merge" Command="{Binding MergeElementsCommand}" CommandParameter="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" ToolTip="Merge selected elements" Width="65" Height="24" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                    <Button Content="🔍 Find/Replace" Command="{Binding ShowFindReplaceCommand}" CommandParameter="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" ToolTip="Find and replace text" Width="85" Height="24" Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontSize="11"/>
                </StackPanel>

                <!-- Selection Toolbar (All/None) -->
                <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                    <Button Content="☑️ Select All" Command="{Binding SelectAllCommand}" ToolTip="Select all visible elements" Width="85" Height="24" Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                    <Button Content="🔲 Select None" Command="{Binding SelectNoneCommand}" ToolTip="Deselect all elements" Width="90" Height="24" Background="#2D2D30" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="0" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,12,0"/>
                    <TextBlock VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="11">
                        <Hyperlink Click="ExpandAll_Click" Foreground="#569CD6" TextDecorations="None">Expand All</Hyperlink>
                        <Run Text="|" Foreground="#555555"/>
                        <Hyperlink Click="CollapseAll_Click" Foreground="#569CD6" TextDecorations="None">Collapse All</Hyperlink>
                    </TextBlock>
                </StackPanel>

                <!-- Categorized Tree View -->
                <Border Grid.Row="3" Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Padding="6">
                    <ListBox x:Name="ElementsListBox" 
                             ItemsSource="{Binding GroupedElementsView}"
                             SelectionMode="Extended"
                             SelectionChanged="ListBox_SelectionChanged"
                             Background="Transparent" 
                             BorderThickness="0" 
                             Foreground="#F1F1F1">
                        <ListBox.GroupStyle>
                            <!-- Level 1: Root Category -->
                            <GroupStyle>
                                <GroupStyle.ContainerStyle>
                                    <Style TargetType="{x:Type GroupItem}">
                                        <Setter Property="Template">
                                            <Setter.Value>
                                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type GroupItem}">
                                                    <Expander IsExpanded="False" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Margin="0,0,0,4">
                                                        <Expander.Header>
                                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="4,2">
                                                                <TextBlock Text="📁" Foreground="#FFD700" Margin="0,0,6,0" FontSize="14"/>
                                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#FFF" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding ItemCount, StringFormat=' ({0})'}" Foreground="#808080" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                            </StackPanel>
                                                        </Expander.Header>
                                                        <ItemsPresenter Margin="15,0,0,0"/>
                                                    </Expander>
                                                </ControlTemplate>
                                            </Setter.Value>
                                        </Setter>
                                    </Style>
                                </GroupStyle.ContainerStyle>
                            </GroupStyle>
                            <!-- Level 2: Revit Class -->
                            <GroupStyle>
                                <GroupStyle.ContainerStyle>
                                    <Style TargetType="{x:Type GroupItem}">
                                        <Setter Property="Template">
                                            <Setter.Value>
                                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type GroupItem}">
                                                    <Expander IsExpanded="False" Margin="0,0,0,4">
                                                        <Expander.Header>
                                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="4,1">
                                                                <TextBlock Text="🏷️" Foreground="#4EC9B0" Margin="0,0,6,0" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="#CCCCCC" FontSize="12" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding ItemCount, StringFormat=' ({0})'}" Foreground="#808080" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                            </StackPanel>
                                                        </Expander.Header>
                                                        <ItemsPresenter Margin="15,0,0,0"/>
                                                    </Expander>
                                                </ControlTemplate>
                                            </Setter.Value>
                                        </Setter>
                                    </Style>
                                </GroupStyle.ContainerStyle>
                            </GroupStyle>
                        </ListBox.GroupStyle>

                        <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate DataType="{x:Type vm:ElementTypeWrapperVM}">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,2">
                                    <TextBlock Text="📄" Foreground="#007ACC" Margin="0,0,6,0" FontSize="13"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" Foreground="#E0E0E0" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ListBox.ItemTemplate>

                        <ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                            <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                                <Setter Property="IsSelected" Value="{Binding IsSelected, Mode=TwoWay}"/>
                                <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                                <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
                                <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6,4"/>
                                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,1"/>
                                <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
                                <Setter Property="ContextMenu">
                                    <Setter.Value>
                                        <ContextMenu Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1">
                                            <MenuItem Header="Duplicate" Command="{Binding DataContext.DuplicateCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" Foreground="White" Background="#2D2D30"/>
                                            <MenuItem Header="Delete" Command="{Binding DataContext.DeleteCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" Foreground="White" Background="#2D2D30"/>
                                            <MenuItem Header="Merge Selected..." Command="{Binding DataContext.MergeElementsCommand, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" CommandParameter="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}" Foreground="White" Background="#2D2D30"/>
                                        </ContextMenu>
                                    </Setter.Value>
                                </Setter>
                                <Style.Resources>
                                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.HighlightBrushKey}" Color="#007ACC"/>
                                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.InactiveSelectionHighlightBrushKey}" Color="#3F3F46"/>
                                    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.HighlightTextBrushKey}" Color="White"/>
                                </Style.Resources>
                                <Style.Triggers>
                                    <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="#007ACC"/>
                                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                                    </Trigger>
                                    <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="#3F3F46"/>
                                    </Trigger>
                                </Style.Triggers>
                            </Style>
                        </ListBox.ItemContainerStyle>
                    </ListBox>
                </Border>
            </Grid>

            <!-- Column Splitter -->
            <GridSplitter Grid.Column="1" Width="5" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Background="Transparent"/>

            <!-- Right Editor Pane (Displays if selected) -->
            <Grid Grid.Column="2" Margin="10,0,0,0">
                <Grid.Style>
                    <Style TargetType="Grid">
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                        <Style.Triggers>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsEditorVisible}" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                            </DataTrigger>
                        </Style.Triggers>
                    </Style>
                </Grid.Style>

                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/> <!-- Header block -->
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>    <!-- Properties Grid -->
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <!-- Element Header -->
                <Border Grid.Row="0" Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Padding="12" Margin="0,0,0,12">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock Text="SELECTED ELEMENT(S)" FontSize="10" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#808080" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                        <TextBox Text="{Binding SelectedElement.Name, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged, ValidatesOnNotifyDataErrors=True}" 
                                 IsEnabled="{Binding IsNameEditingAllowed}"
                                 FontSize="14" FontWeight="SemiBold" Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#FFF" BorderThickness="1" Padding="8,5" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <TextBox.Style>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBox">
                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#808080"/>
                                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="Transparent"/>
                                            <Setter Property="FontStyle" Value="Italic"/>
                                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                        <Trigger Property="Validation.HasError" Value="true">
                                            <Setter Property="ToolTip" Value="{Binding RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}, Path=(Validation.Errors)[0].ErrorContent}"/>
                                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="Red"/>
                                            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1.5"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </TextBox.Style>
                            <Validation.ErrorTemplate>
                                <ControlTemplate>
                                    <DockPanel>
                                        <Border BorderBrush="Red" BorderThickness="1.5" CornerRadius="2">
                                            <AdornedElementPlaceholder x:Name="controlWithError"/>
                                        </Border>
                                        <TextBlock Text="⚠️" Foreground="Red" FontSize="14" Margin="6,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" ToolTip="{Binding ElementName=controlWithError, Path=AdornedElement.(Validation.Errors)[0].ErrorContent}"/>
                                    </DockPanel>
                                </ControlTemplate>
                            </Validation.ErrorTemplate>
                        </TextBox>

                        <!-- Aliases Section -->
                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="Aliases:" Foreground="#808080" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                            <Grid Grid.Column="1">
                                <TextBox x:Name="AliasesTextBox" 
                                         Text="{Binding SelectedAliasesString}" 
                                         IsEnabled="{Binding IsNameEditingAllowed}"
                                         Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#FFF" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" Padding="6,4" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBox.Style>
                                        <Style TargetType="TextBox">
                                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46"/>
                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#808080"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="Transparent"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="FontStyle" Value="Italic"/>
                                                </Trigger>
                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                        </Style>
                                    </TextBox.Style>
                                </TextBox>
                                <TextBlock IsHitTestVisible="False" 
                                           Text="e.g. Alias1, Alias2" 
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" 
                                           HorizontalAlignment="Left" 
                                           Margin="8,0,0,0" 
                                           Foreground="#808080" 
                                           FontStyle="Italic">
                                    <TextBlock.Style>
                                        <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Text, ElementName=AliasesTextBox}" Value="">
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                </DataTrigger>
                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                        </Style>
                                    </TextBlock.Style>
                                </TextBlock>
                            </Grid>
                        </Grid>

                        <WrapPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="Class: " Foreground="#808080"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedDisplayClass}" Foreground="#CCCCCC" Margin="0,0,20,0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="Category: " Foreground="#808080"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding SelectedDisplayCategory}" Foreground="#CCCCCC"/>
                        </WrapPanel>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Border>

                <!-- Property Grid (DataGrid) -->
                <DataGrid Grid.Row="1" 
                          ItemsSource="{Binding DisplayParameters}" 
                          AutoGenerateColumns="False" 
                          CanUserAddRows="False" 
                          CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                          HeadersVisibility="Column"
                          GridLinesVisibility="Horizontal"
                          BorderThickness="1"
                          BorderBrush="#3F3F46"
                          Background="#2D2D30"
                          RowBackground="#2D2D30"
                          AlternatingRowBackground="#252526"
                          Foreground="#F1F1F1"
                          RowHeaderWidth="0"
                          HorizontalGridLinesBrush="#3F3F46"
                          VerticalGridLinesBrush="Transparent">
                    
                    <DataGrid.Resources>
                        <Style TargetType="DataGridColumnHeader">
                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1E1E1E" />
                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#CCCCCC" />
                            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0,0,0,1" />
                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46" />
                            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,8" />
                            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" />
                        </Style>
                        <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" />
                            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0" />
                            <Style.Resources>
                                <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.HighlightBrushKey}" Color="Transparent"/>
                                <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.InactiveSelectionHighlightBrushKey}" Color="Transparent"/>
                            </Style.Resources>
                        </Style>
                    </DataGrid.Resources>

                    <DataGrid.Columns>
                        <!-- Parameter Name -->
                        <DataGridTextColumn Header="Parameter Name" 
                                            Binding="{Binding Name}" 
                                            IsReadOnly="True" 
                                            Width="220">
                            <DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                    <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6"/>
                                    <Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#E0E0E0"/>
                                    <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Medium"/>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGridTextColumn.ElementStyle>
                        </DataGridTextColumn>

                        <!-- Parameter Value -->
                        <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Value" Width="*">
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <Grid>
                                        <!-- Default TextBox -->
                                        <TextBox x:Name="DefaultValueBox"
                                                 Text="{Binding Value, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged, ValidatesOnNotifyDataErrors=True}"
                                                 BorderThickness="1" Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#F1F1F1" Padding="6,4" Margin="4,2" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBox.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBox">
                                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsReadOnly}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"/>
                                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#808080"/>
                                                            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="Transparent"/>
                                                            <Setter Property="FontStyle" Value="Italic"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StorageType}" Value="ElementId">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StorageType}" Value="ComplexNested">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBox.Style>
                                            <Validation.ErrorTemplate>
                                                <ControlTemplate>
                                                    <DockPanel>
                                                        <Border BorderBrush="Red" BorderThickness="1.5" CornerRadius="2">
                                                            <AdornedElementPlaceholder x:Name="controlWithError"/>
                                                        </Border>
                                                        <TextBlock Text="⚠️" Foreground="Red" FontSize="14" Margin="6,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" ToolTip="{Binding ElementName=controlWithError, Path=AdornedElement.(Validation.Errors)[0].ErrorContent}"/>
                                                    </DockPanel>
                                                </ControlTemplate>
                                            </Validation.ErrorTemplate>
                                        </TextBox>

                                        <!-- ElementId ComboBox -->
                                        <ComboBox x:Name="ReferenceCombo"
                                                  ItemsSource="{Binding AvailableReferences}"
                                                  SelectedItem="{Binding Value, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                  IsEditable="True"
                                                  IsReadOnly="True"
                                                  BorderThickness="1" Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#F1F1F1" Padding="6,4" Margin="4,2" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <ComboBox.Resources>
                                                <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.WindowBrushKey}" Color="#1E1E1E"/>
                                                <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.WindowTextBrushKey}" Color="#F1F1F1"/>
                                                <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.HighlightBrushKey}" Color="#007ACC"/>
                                                <SolidColorBrush x:Key="{x:Static SystemColors.HighlightTextBrushKey}" Color="White"/>
                                            </ComboBox.Resources>
                                            <ComboBox.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="ComboBox">
                                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StorageType}" Value="ElementId">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsReadOnly}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="IsEnabled" Value="False"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </ComboBox.Style>
                                        </ComboBox>

                                        <!-- ComplexNested Button -->
                                        <Button x:Name="NestedEditButton"
                                                Content="[ Edit Nested Data... ]"
                                                Command="{Binding EditNestedDataCommand}"
                                                BorderThickness="1" Background="#3F3F46" Foreground="White" Padding="6,4" Margin="4,2" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <Button.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="Button">
                                                    <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#3F3F46"/>
                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding StorageType}" Value="ComplexNested">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </Button.Style>
                                        </Button>
                                    </Grid>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                        </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                    </DataGrid.Columns>
                </DataGrid>
            </Grid>

            <!-- Placeholder (when selection is null) -->
            <Border Grid.Column="2" Background="#2D2D30" BorderBrush="#3F3F46" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Margin="10,0,0,0" Padding="30">
                <Border.Style>
                    <Style TargetType="Border">
                        <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                        <Style.Triggers>
                            <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding IsEditorVisible}" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                            </DataTrigger>
                        </Style.Triggers>
                    </Style>
                </Border.Style>
                <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="🔍" FontSize="48" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,15" Foreground="#808080"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="No Element Selected" FontSize="16" FontWeight="SemiBold" Foreground="#FFF" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Select standard elements from the left navigation tree to inspect and edit their parameters." Foreground="#808080" TextAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

### File: src/SyntheticShared/Modules/StandardsManagement/Views/JsonEditorWindow.xaml.cs
```csharp
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Synthetic.Shared.UI;
using Synthetic.Core;
using Synthetic.Modules.RevitDOM;
using Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.ViewModels;
namespace Synthetic.Modules.StandardsManagement.Views
{
    public partial class JsonEditorWindow : Window
    {
        public JsonEditorWindow(IntPtr mainWindowHandle)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            RevitWindowHelper.SetOwner(this, mainWindowHandle);
        }
        private bool _isSyncingSelection = false;
        private void ListBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isSyncingSelection) return;
            if (DataContext is JsonEditorMainViewModel vm)
            {
                _isSyncingSelection = true;
                try
                {
                    vm.SelectedElements.Clear();
                    if (sender is System.Windows.Controls.ListBox listBox)
                    {
                        foreach (var item in listBox.SelectedItems)
                        {
                            if (item is ElementTypeWrapperVM el)
                            {
                                vm.SelectedElements.Add(el);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    vm.UpdateSelectedElementsFromListBox();
                }
                finally
                {
                    _isSyncingSelection = false;
                }
            }
        }
        private void ExpandAll_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SetAllExpanders(true);
        }
        private void CollapseAll_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            SetAllExpanders(false);
        }
        private void SetAllExpanders(bool expand)
        {
            var expanders = FindVisualChildren<Expander>(ElementsListBox);
            foreach (var expander in expanders)
            {
                expander.IsExpanded = expand;
            }
        }
        private static System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<T> FindVisualChildren<T>(DependencyObject depObj) where T : DependencyObject
        {
            if (depObj != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(depObj); i++)
                {
                    DependencyObject child = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(depObj, i);
                    if (child != null)
                    {
                        if (child is T t)
                        {
                            yield return t;
                        }
                        foreach (T childOfChild in FindVisualChildren<T>(child))
                        {
                            yield return childOfChild;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
